items.name: agent-action-approve
items.title: Agent Action Approve
items.description: Stops an AI agent's tool call from doing something nobody approved by reading the call itself and saying in plain words what it will delete, send or change, how far that reaches (one file up to a whole drive or production) and whether it can be undone, marking the one token that changes everything (a lone \ that means the drive root, an unset $VAR, ../, a C:/Users/ALEX~1 short name), setting what the agent said beside what the call does when they disagree, checking MCP read-only labels against the call, reading inside bash -c, cmd /c and encoded PowerShell, flagging curl | bash, making dangerous calls hold-to-approve, and showing what an "always allow" rule would also let through while refusing one for npx, bash -c, chained commands and anything irreversible.

meta.stops: AI agent wipes a whole drive
mistakes: agent ran rm -rf on wrong folder

items.name: mcp-tool-review
items.title: MCP Tool Review
items.description: Stops an MCP rug pull, where a server changes its tools after you approved them, by fingerprinting each tool definition, diffing the new description word by word against the approved one, marking the poisoned phrases inside the added text (<IMPORTANT> blocks, "do not tell the user", ~/.ssh and mcp.json, instructions about another server's send_email), flagging new free-text parameters that could carry data out, invisible characters and read-only labels that flipped, and letting the person keep the approved version, turn the tool off or accept the change, with a second press for anything suspicious and a one-tap accept for the safe ones.

meta.stops: MCP server swaps in poisoned tools

items.name: reset-hard-readback
items.title: Reset Hard Readback
items.description: Stops git reset --hard, git clean -fdx, git checkout -- . and git stash drop from silently destroying work by reading porcelain status and listing exactly what will be lost (edited files with +/- lines, staged new files, untracked and ignored files with .env and keys first, commits the branch moves past with unpushed ones marked, stash entries with the id to recover them), saying what stays, and offering to stash first.

meta.stops: Uncommitted work wiped by git reset
mistakes: git reset hard lost my changes

items.name: account-deletion-readback
items.title: Account Deletion Readback
items.description: Stops an account deletion that loses more than the user expects or keeps charging them: before Delete it reads back what goes, teams left with no owner (with a transfer button), App Store and Google Play subscriptions that keep billing until cancelled there, the date it can be restored until, what the law keeps and a data export, and unlocks Delete only after a typed confirmation, labelled "Delete without export" until a copy is taken, and lets the user schedule deletion for when a paid period ends instead of losing paid time.

items.name: force-push-confirm
items.title: Force Push Confirm
items.description: Stops a force push from silently deleting work on the remote by listing every commit it would drop with author, message and age, marking other people's commits (co-authors and GitHub noreply addresses included) and protected branches, building a --force-with-lease command pinned to the tip you were shown (or --force-if-includes, so an IDE's background fetch can't defeat the lease), and asking you to type the branch name only when someone else's work would be lost.

meta.stops: Teammates' commits erased by force push

items.name: infra-plan-readback
items.title: Infra Plan Readback
items.description: Stops a Terraform or OpenTofu apply from quietly destroying data by reading the `terraform show -json` plan back as create, update, replace and destroy counts, putting destroys and replacements of databases, buckets, volumes and keys first with the attribute that forces each replacement (before → after, sensitive values hidden), whether the old one goes before its replacement exists and what force_destroy or skip_final_snapshot will do, flagging production workspaces and a var.environment that says production when the workspace doesn't, and keeping Apply locked until each data loss is acknowledged and, in production, the workspace name is typed.

meta.stops: Production database destroyed by terraform apply

items.name: recovery-contact-cooldown
items.title: Recovery Contact Cooldown
items.description: Stops account takeovers that start by swapping the recovery email or phone by making the security hold visible: it says what the contact is changing to (masked), drains a countdown to when it takes effect, notes that codes still go to the old contact meanwhile, turns urgent in the last hour, and offers a one-tap cancel plus a "this wasn't me" path, announcing only the outcome, never the ticking.

meta.stops: Account hijacked via swapped recovery email

items.name: migration-preview
items.title: Migration Preview
items.description: Stops migrations that take production down or lose data by reading Postgres SQL back step by step (strings, dollar quotes and comments handled), showing what each step locks and whether it touches every row of a big table, marking dropped tables and columns as impossible to undo, and catching NOT NULL columns that will fail, renames that break code mid-deploy, CONCURRENTLY inside a transaction and a missing lock_timeout, with a one-tap safer sequence and undo.

meta.stops: Migration locks production table for hours

items.name: feature-flag-rollout
items.title: Feature Flag Rollout
items.description: Prevents a risky flag release by reading back exactly who gets it (segments plus a percentage of everyone else, in users), asking for a second click before production skips ramp steps or gets ahead of staging, and warning how many users lose the feature on a pullback.

meta.stops: Feature flag released to everyone early

items.name: branch-target
items.title: Branch Target
items.description: Prevents merging or deploying into the wrong place by checking the chosen base against branch rules (feature → main is caught, with a one-tap switch to develop), counting commits the branch drags in that aren't its own, and flagging a head that is behind its target with an Update branch action.

meta.stops: Feature branch merged into wrong base
mistakes: merged into main instead of develop

items.name: session-list
items.title: Session List
items.description: Stops people signing themselves out while cleaning up sessions: this device is pinned and marked, "Sign out all others" can never include it, signing out here asks once inline with Cancel focused, and sessions from another country are flagged with honest "approximate location" wording.

meta.stops: Signed out own device by mistake
mistakes: sign out all logged me out
cant tell which session is mine

items.name: sign-in-approve
items.title: Sign-in Approve
items.description: Stops MFA-fatigue approvals: there is no one-tap Approve, the user must type the number from the sign-in screen, and the prompt shows location and device, warns about request bursts and numbers sent by "support", refuses after wrong guesses and ends every denial on a secure-my-account step.

meta.stops: Attacker's login approved through push fatigue

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to Confirm
items.description: Prevents stray clicks and taps from triggering destructive actions: the button fires only after a full press-and-hold (mouse, touch or keyboard), rewinds on early release, shows "Hold to confirm" when someone just clicks, and lets screen reader and switch users, who can't hold, confirm with a second press instead.

meta.stops: Destructive action fired by stray click

items.name: two-step-button
items.title: Two-Step Button
items.description: Prevents one-click destruction: the first click arms the button with a draining timer, a second deliberate click confirms, and accidental double-clicks, held keys, blur, Escape or the timeout all disarm it.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: Slide to Confirm
items.description: Prevents accidental taps and pocket presses from sending payments or ending sessions: the thumb must travel the whole track, a held arrow key stops short, and an async confirm shows a pending state.

items.name: type-to-confirm
items.title: Type to Confirm
items.description: Prevents deleting the wrong thing on reflex: a GitHub-style dialog that unlocks only after the exact phrase is typed, highlighting the matched characters and flagging a typo as it happens.

items.name: undo-toast
items.title: Undo Toast
items.description: Prevents irreversible mistakes without an "Are you sure?": actions run optimistically and only commit after an undo window with a countdown ring that pauses on hover, focus or a hidden tab, Ctrl/⌘+Z, a commit when the page closes, and a rollback with a clear notice when the commit fails.

meta.stops: Deleted item gone with no undo

items.name: impact-preview
items.title: Impact Preview
items.description: Prevents surprise cascade deletes by loading and listing everything that goes with a parent object, grouped by type with counts and samples and marked deleted, detached or kept, and keeps Confirm locked until the list loads.

items.name: bulk-scope-confirm
items.title: Bulk Scope Confirm
items.description: Prevents bulk actions from hitting more than intended by stating the exact count and risky subsets, defaulting to only this page, and locking Confirm if the match count changes while it is open.

mistakes: applied to all pages not just this

items.name: cooldown-button
items.title: Cooldown Button
items.description: Prevents resend spam and double charges by enforcing escalating cooldowns per attempt (30s, 60s, 120s) with a visible countdown and reason, persisted in sessionStorage so a refresh can't bypass it.

items.name: safe-submit
items.title: Safe Submit
items.description: Stops double charges and duplicate records by collapsing repeated clicks, Enter spam and double-taps into one request, with an idempotency key that is reused on retry after a network error.

items.name: drop-confirm
items.title: Drop Confirm
items.description: Stops accidental drag-and-drop moves: the target names exactly what will move and where, ignores a drop that lands before the pointer has rested on it, asks once before large moves or moves that change who can see the items, and offers Undo, with a Move here button for keyboard and touch.

mistakes: drag and drop moved wrong folder

items.name: danger-zone
items.title: Danger Zone
items.description: Stops a stray click in settings from deleting or transferring something: destructive actions stay listed with their consequences but locked until the user deliberately unlocks the section, which locks itself again after one action, an idle timeout, Escape, a hidden tab or focus leaving it.

mistakes: delete button in settings clicked by mistake

items.name: click-shield
items.title: Click Shield
items.description: Stops clicks that land on a button only because it just appeared, shifted under the cursor or changed its label, by ignoring pointer presses for ~500ms with a quiet fade-in cue, while keyboard users are only shielded from focus that code moved onto the button.

items.name: shortcut-confirm
items.title: Shortcut Confirm
items.description: Stops a slipped finger from firing a destructive keyboard shortcut: the first press only shows "Press ⌘⌫ again to delete 3 items", and only a separate second press within the window confirms, never a held key, an extra modifier, a stray key in between or a keystroke meant for a text field.

items.name: guarded-switch
items.title: Guarded Switch
items.description: Stops a critical setting like maintenance mode or a kill switch being flipped by a stray click: a see-through cover, like an aircraft switch guard, must be lifted first, says what flipping will do while it's up, drops back on its own, and reads back the consequence after the change.

items.name: swipe-delete-row
items.title: Swipe Delete Row
items.description: Prevents accidental swipe-deletes: the row only deletes when dragged past a visible line (not by a fast flick or a vertical scroll), resists like a rubber band, springs back if released early, has a trash button for keyboard users, and keeps an Undo before the delete commits.

items.name: grace-send
items.title: Grace Send
items.description: Catches the regretted send: pressing Send starts a short countdown with a draining ring before the irreversible action fires, so Cancel, Escape or a leave-page warning can stop it, while Send now skips the wait.

items.name: bulk-runner
items.title: Bulk Runner
items.description: Stops bulk jobs from ending in "some of it happened, probably": live done/failed/remaining counts, Pause and Stop that let in-flight items finish and then say exactly what was and wasn't done, failures grouped by reason with retry-failed-only, and a progress bar that never jumps backwards.

meta.stops: Bulk job half done, nobody knows

items.name: two-person-approve
items.title: Two-Person Approve
items.description: Enforces the two-person rule for high-risk actions: the requester can't approve their own request, approval is bound to a fingerprint of exactly what will run so an edited plan has to be re-reviewed, rejections need a reason, and expired requests can't be approved.

meta.stops: Requester approved their own risky change

items.name: trash-countdown
items.title: Trash Countdown
items.description: Stops things vanishing for good by surprise: trashed items show how long until they're deleted forever, soon-to-purge items are highlighted, restore is one tap, and emptying the trash needs the typed item count, which resets if new items arrive mid-confirmation.

items.name: range-select-guard
items.title: Range Select Guard
items.description: Catches runaway shift-click selections: it reads back how many rows a range just selected with Undo, skips and reports rows hidden by the filter, flags rows on pages you never opened with an 'only this page' fix, and calls out selected rows a filter has hidden.

items.name: reauth-gate
items.title: Reauth Gate
items.description: Sudo mode for sensitive actions: it asks for a passkey, password or PIN through your own verify function, names the exact action and why it's asking, runs the queued action right after confirmation, and remembers it for a short window shown as a countdown chip you can end early.

meta.stops: Sensitive action on unattended logged-in laptop

items.name: rollback-preview
items.title: Rollback Preview
items.description: Prevents rollbacks that undo more or less than you expect by listing what reverts, what won't undo (irreversible migrations, data written since), the target's age and every newer version it skips, and confirming only when you type the target's name, calling out a different version's name instead of silently not matching.

meta.stops: Rollback skipped more versions than expected

items.name: edit-lock
items.title: Edit Lock
items.description: Prevents accidental edits to finished or approved records by locking the form in a disabled fieldset ("Locked by Priya after approval"), stating before unlocking that any change needs re-approval, voiding the approval only when something actually changes, and relocking itself after a stretch of idleness, never mid-typing.

items.name: spend-cap-button
items.title: Spend Cap Button
items.description: Prevents duplicate purchases and overspending: it remembers recent buys of the same item ("You bought this 3 min ago", including a double-click a second ago) and needs a deliberate second click to buy again, previews this purchase as a slice of each daily or monthly cap, and blocks any spend that would break a cap with the overage and when it resets.

meta.stops: Same item bought twice by mistake

items.name: scheduled-queue
items.title: Scheduled Queue
items.description: Prevents scheduled sends going out wrong or unnoticed: each row counts down live, the last-chance window highlights and counts down to the real cancel cutoff (when the provider locks the send in), sends landing in quiet hours where the audience lives get a one-tap move to a sane hour, missed sends are flagged, and rescheduling refuses a time in the past.

mistakes: scheduled send went out wrong time

items.name: archive-or-delete
items.title: Archive or Delete
items.description: Stops someone from permanently deleting what they only meant to put away: Archive and Delete sit side by side with each affected thing's honest fate under both, the reversible choice starts selected and focused so Enter archives, and picking Delete flashes what is lost and relabels the button "Delete forever".

items.name: revoke-access-preview
items.title: Revoke Access Preview
items.description: Stops a member, token or app removal from silently orphaning their work and breaking things: it lists what they lose, what they own with a reassign-to picker and one-tap reassign-all, sessions that end now (flagging any in use this minute) and integrations that stop because they run on that person's credentials, and the button says if anything will be left unowned.

items.name: transfer-ownership
items.title: Transfer Ownership
items.description: Stops ownership landing on the wrong person or the wrong plan: it reads back what moves and what you keep, warns when the email is outside your org with a one-tap switch to the colleague you probably meant, blocks a recipient whose plan can't own it, and only transfers once they accept, showing the pending request and its expiry meanwhile.

items.name: cancel-readback
items.title: Cancel Readback
items.description: Stops people cancelling blind, or being tricked out of it: the cancel screen reads back the exact date and time access ends, what is lost and kept and the refund (or plainly that there is none), offers pause or downgrade once below a cancel button that never moves, and ends on a receipt with an undo.

meta.stops: Cancelled without knowing when access ends

items.name: merge-records
items.title: Merge Records
items.description: Stops a duplicate merge from silently throwing data away: each field defaults to the most recent non-empty value, real conflicts are marked (ignoring case and spacing), and a live readback names every value that will be discarded, which record keeps its ID, and which links move to it.

items.name: move-readback
items.title: Move Readback
items.description: Stops a move from quietly changing who can see something: it reads back the destination path with the folder that sets access highlighted, says how many people gain or lose access ("Moving into Public makes it visible to 40 people"), counts path links that will break with a one-tap redirect, lists inherited settings that change, and relabels the button when the move widens the audience.

meta.stops: Private doc moved into public folder

items.name: reset-preview
items.title: Reset Preview
items.description: Stops "Reset to defaults" from wiping customizations nobody looked at: it lists only the settings the user changed as current → default, lets them keep any, warns with a one-tap export until a copy is saved, and offers a draining Undo after the reset.

items.name: replace-file
items.title: Replace File
items.description: Stops an upload from overwriting a newer file with an older one: each name clash shows both copies side by side with thumbnail, size and date (newer and larger in bold), warns with a one-tap "Keep both" when an older file would replace a newer one, spots identical copies, previews the renamed copy, and applies one choice to all with counts while saying the other files upload as normal.

items.name: dns-record-guard
items.title: DNS Record Guard
items.description: Stops a DNS edit or delete from quietly breaking things by checking it against the whole zone before saving: email that stops (a removed MX, SPF senders dropped or doubled past the 10-lookup limit, a DKIM selector removed, escalated when the DMARC policy enforces it), a CNAME at the root or beside other records and names left pointing at nothing, then saying how long the change takes to spread with a one-tap “lower TTL first” that counts down until old caches clear.

meta.stops: Deleted MX record stopped company email

items.name: key-rotate
items.title: Key Rotate
items.description: Stops an API key rotation from taking production down by keeping old and new keys valid until a stated time, showing which clients have been seen on the new key, flagging jobs that won't call again before the old key expires with a one-tap longer window, and blocking an immediate cut-off while the old key is still in use unless you say it leaked.

items.name: retention-change
items.title: Retention Change
items.description: Stops a shorter data-retention period from destroying data by surprise by saying exactly what goes and when (“Lowering to 30 days deletes 14,210 events older than 13 Sep, tonight at 02:00”), shading the doomed days on a chart, counting down to the purge while changing it back still loses nothing, and naming the confirm button “Delete without export” until an export-first is done.

meta.stops: Shorter retention purged months of data

items.name: seat-reduce
items.title: Seat Reduce
items.description: Stops a lower seat count from cutting people off silently by making you choose who goes, suggesting unaccepted invites first and then the least active members (never the owner or admins), calling out an admin or someone active today if you pick them, and showing the new bill, when it starts and what happens to each person's work before you confirm.

meta.stops: Fewer seats locked out active admin

items.name: fx-send-receive
items.title: FX Send Receive
items.description: Stops an international payment arriving short by locking the side you typed (send or receive), measuring what actually arrives against the invoice, and catching the invoice figure typed into "You send", an invoice in another currency, SHA bank deductions on the way and overpaying, each fixed in one tap by sliding the lock to "They receive" at the exact amount or switching charges to OUR.

mistakes: typed amount in you send instead of they receive

items.name: leftover-text-check
items.title: Leftover Text Check
items.description: Stops text being published with the parts nobody meant to keep: chatbot chatter and refusals ("I cannot fulfill that request"), unfilled placeholders ([product], [task 1], XX%), TK and TODO markers and a paragraph pasted twice, with no false alarms on [1], [sic] or Markdown links, flagging them the moment they are pasted, deleting a chatter sentence in one tap, filling every copy of a placeholder at once, and asking for a second press to publish with leftovers.

mistakes: as an ai language model in content
forgot to fill in template brackets

items.name: ai-citation-check
items.title: AI Citation Check
items.description: Stops made-up references going out in AI-written text by flagging the tells with a reason for each (a DOI prefix that doesn't belong to the journal it names, a long dash inside a DOI, a case cited to F.3d for a year after 2021, a year that hasn't happened, leftover oaicite and 【4†source】 markers, long quotes with nothing saying who said them), looking every DOI, case and link up through a pluggable verify such as Crossref or CourtListener, calling anything it couldn't confirm "Unverified" rather than fine, fixing dashes and markers in one tap, and asking for a second press to submit with references that may not exist.

meta.stops: Fake case cited in a court filing

items.name: commit-combobox
items.title: Commit Combobox
items.description: Stops a pick-from-list field saving text the user only typed, or a stale pick they typed over: unpicked text is matched on blur (an exact match is picked, a misspelling gets a one-tap Did you mean, two same-named options ask which), editing after a pick visibly drops it with Undo or Esc, and the stored option is always read back.

meta.stops: Typed text saved instead of a pick

items.name: relative-date-input
items.title: Relative Date Input
items.description: Stops a date typed the way people say it from landing on the wrong day: "next Fri", "in 2 weeks", "the 15th" and "23 Oct" are read with date-fns against today, and phrases that split listeners ("next Friday" on a Wednesday, "this Monday" after Monday, "the 10th" once it has passed, "next weekend" early in the week) show both dates and wait for a pick, with a read-back and a one-tap rewrite to the unambiguous date.

meta.stops: Next Friday lands on the wrong day

items.name: namesake-select
items.title: Namesake Select
items.description: Stops “right name, wrong person” picks (the second Ravi Kumar one row down, a patient or customer with a twin) by flagging options that share a name regardless of case, accents or word order with only the details that tell them apart, asking for one identifier among the namesakes before a shared name becomes the value (the ID re-entry that cut wrong-patient orders most in a randomized trial), offering a one-tap switch when the answer belongs to the other person, reading the choice back with two identifiers and calling out identical records as likely duplicates, in a list that flips and shrinks instead of clipping.

meta.stops: Right name picked for wrong person

items.name: k8s-resource-input
items.title: K8s Resource Input
items.description: Stops Kubernetes requests and limits that the API rejects or quietly misreads by reading each value back in plain units and catching CPU 500 meaning 500 cores, 400m of memory meaning 0.4 bytes, 512MB and other case-sensitive unit slips, a 1G limit sitting under a 1Gi request, CPU finer than 1m (rounded up) and requests bigger than any node, each with a one-tap fix, plus the pod's QoS class and a pasted resources: block filling all four fields.

mistakes: mi vs mb in k8s yaml

items.name: connection-string-input
items.title: Connection String Input
items.description: Stops a database URL that fails to connect or connects insecurely by masking the password whenever it isn't being edited, reading back the user, host, database and TLS mode the driver will really use, and catching an unencoded @, #, / or % in the password (naming the host a strict parser would try instead), localhost in production, a missing, weak or misspelled sslmode, unknown libpq parameters, a port that belongs to another database, redis:// and MongoDB URLs without TLS (including mongodb+srv:// with tls=false), sslrootcert=system with a weaker sslmode, a colon in a MongoDB password, and quotes or KEY= pasted from a .env file, each with a one-tap fix and a copy-without-password button.

meta.stops: Database URL leaks or skips TLS

items.name: epoch-input
items.title: Epoch Input
items.description: Stops a timestamp field storing the wrong moment by reading the value back as a date in the user's zone and in UTC, and catching milliseconds pasted where seconds belong (year 57,754), microseconds and nanoseconds, Excel serials, Windows FILETIME and .NET ticks, ISO strings with no time zone that JavaScript reads as local time and servers as UTC, date-only strings read as UTC midnight, impossible dates like 30 February, years and compact dates (2026, 20261014) that silently read as 1970, and values past the 2038 limit of 32-bit time, each with a one-tap conversion and copy-as seconds, milliseconds or ISO.

items.name: package-name-check
items.title: Package Name Check
items.description: Stops an npm or pip install pulling in a typosquat by reading the install command or requirements list package by package and catching lookalikes of popular packages (loadsh, crossenv, cross-env.js, jeIlyfish with a capital I, colourama), import names that aren't the package to install (sklearn, cv2, bs4, PIL), built-ins installed from the registry (fs, crypto, json), names npm or PyPI can't publish, and, through an optional registry lookup, names that don't exist yet (the AI-hallucination trap) or appeared days ago with almost no downloads, each with a one-tap switch to the real package.

items.name: cheque-check
items.title: Cheque Check
items.description: Stops a cheque being deposited after it expires, before its date or with a correction clearing will reject, by reading the date the way it's written in the CTS boxes (so 31 November is caught), showing the safe deposit window under RBI's 3-month rule and warning on the disputed last day, catching a January cheque still carrying last year's date and a two-digit year, and saying when Positive Pay is needed, with one-tap date fixes.

meta.stops: Cheque bounced as expired or post-dated

items.name: kyc-name-match
items.title: KYC Name Match
items.description: Stops a KYC or PAN–Aadhaar submission failing on a name that doesn't match the documents, by comparing the typed name with each document word by word (order, initials, a missing middle name, transliterations like Laxmi and Lakshmi), checking the PAN's 4th and 5th letters against the holder type and surname, flagging a date of birth or gender that differs between documents (which UIDAI says must be identical), and offering each document's exact name in one tap.

items.name: aadhaar-input
items.title: Aadhaar Input
items.description: Prevents rejected KYC and over-exposed Aadhaar numbers by masking the entry as XXXX XXXX 1234 while typing (reveal on demand), checking the Verhoeff digit and the never-0-or-1 first digit, offering a one-tap reveal when the check digit fails (instead of guessing a swap that is often wrong), recognising a VID, the 28-digit enrolment ID, a masked copy, a PAN or a mobile number (with or without +91) pasted by mistake, cleaning photocopy spaces and dashes, and saying that a VID or masked number is enough and how the number is stored.

items.name: cache-control-input
items.title: Cache Control Input
items.description: Stops cache headers from leaking or stranding content by reading back who stores the response and for how long (browser, CDN via CDN-Cache-Control or Surrogate-Control, other shared caches) and flagging per-user pages a CDN can cache, a cookie-setting response made public, no-cache mistaken for no-store, immutable on URLs that keep their name, a missing Vary for compressed or negotiated bodies and HTML kept for days, each with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Private page cached by the CDN

items.name: password-policy-input
items.title: Password Policy Input
items.description: Stops admins shipping password rules that make accounts weaker by reading the policy back against NIST SP 800-63B-4: it flags banned composition rules, forced rotation, security questions and hints, minimums under 15 (8 with MFA), maximums under 64, blocked paste, no breached-password check and no failed-sign-in limit, shows what the rules do to real passwords (Password1! accepted, a long passphrase refused), and fixes each rule or applies NIST defaults in one tap.

items.name: mrz-paste-input
items.title: MRZ Paste Input
items.description: Stops misread passport details reaching a booking or KYC form by validating a pasted or typed passport MRZ (ICAO 9303 TD3) check digit by check digit, catching OCR slips like O for 0 and K for <, swapped lines, CRLF and stray spaces, proposing the likeliest fix for a wrong check digit (cross-checked against the composite digit) and flagging an expired or soon-expiring passport, then filling in name, number, nationality, dates and sex.

items.name: notice-period-check
items.title: Notice Period Check
items.description: Stops people resigning towards the wrong last day by working it out from the resignation and the notice policy (days, weeks or months, calendar or working days, notice from the same or the next day) and flagging month-end arithmetic like 31 Jan + 1 month, a last day on a weekend or holiday, an email HR dates differently in its own time zone, unpaid leave pushing the date out, leave set-off and the buyout cost of leaving early, with one-tap fixes and a line to copy to HR.

meta.stops: Wrong last working day after resigning

items.name: tax-regime-compare
items.title: Tax Regime Compare
items.description: Stops salaried people in India picking the tax regime that costs them more by working out tax year 2026-27 tax under the old and new regimes from salary, HRA (with the 8 cities at 50% under rule 279), 80C, 80D, NPS and home-loan interest, showing the break-even deductions, and flagging a choice that costs more, deductions that don't count under the new regime and claims over their limit, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: curl-pipe-guard
items.title: Curl Pipe Guard
items.description: Stops an install one-liner from running a script you didn't mean to trust by showing, before a curl | sh (or wget, or iwr | iex) is copied or run, the script's real host and flagging plain http, raw IPs, shortened links, a host that isn't the product's docs domain, sudo, -k/--insecure, a missing checksum and a missing -f, then offering the same install as download, inspect, verify and run steps to copy instead.

items.name: port-expose-guard
items.title: Port Expose Guard
items.description: Stops a database or admin port being published to the internet by accident: it reads a docker run command, compose ports or a Kubernetes Service back as who can reach each port, flags databases bound to 0.0.0.0 (which Docker opens ahead of ufw), host networking, -P, NodePort or public LoadBalancer for internal services, a container port the image doesn't listen on and unquoted 22:22 that YAML reads as 1342, and fixes each in one tap (bind to 127.0.0.1, ClusterIP, the right port, quotes). It reads ${VAR} ports, long and { … } compose syntax and [::] binds, keeps CRLF line endings, and notes that 127.0.0.1 was LAN-reachable before Docker 28.

meta.stops: Database port open to the internet

items.name: passenger-name-input
items.title: Passenger Name Input
items.description: Prevents denied boarding and name-change fees by checking a flight or train passenger name against the ID, catching swapped names, a missing middle name, a title, suffix or nickname typed into the name, single-name passengers, accents the ticket can't print and names over the airline's limit, each with a one-tap fix, and reading it back as SURNAME/GIVEN TITLE the way it will print.

meta.stops: Boarding denied over a ticket name

items.name: emi-readback
items.title: EMI Readback
items.description: Stops a borrower signing for the wrong loan by reading back EMI, total interest, processing fee with GST, other upfront charges, what actually reaches the account and the real yearly cost (APR, computed the way RBI's Key Facts Statement does), catching tenure typed in months when years were meant (and the reverse), a monthly rate typed as yearly, a flat rate that hides a far higher reducing rate and fees that eat the loan, each with the EMI both ways and a one-tap fix, plus what a prepayment saves.

meta.stops: Signed for a loan costing more

items.name: leave-request-check
items.title: Leave Request Check
items.description: Stops a time-off request costing more (or meaning something else) than the person thinks by reading it back day by day as calendar days, working days and the leave it really uses, and flagging weekends and holidays at the ends, a sandwich rule from your policy that charges the weekend in between, a half day with no half chosen or one that leaves a working gap, a balance going negative and teammates already away, with one-tap fixes and the date they're back at work.

items.name: photo-spec-check
items.title: Photo Spec Check
items.description: Stops exam, passport and visa photos being rejected after upload by checking them against the portal's rules (UPSC, SSC, NTA, NEET and US visa presets, or your own): the real file type behind the name, KB, pixels, shape, print size, over-compression, face size and centring when a face box is passed, a background that isn't white and black-and-white photos, with a one-tap canvas fix that crops around the face, resizes and re-encodes into the KB window.

items.name: doc-upload-match
items.title: Doc Upload Match
items.description: Stops a KYC upload being rejected days later by checking the file against the document asked for (Aadhaar back instead of front, Aadhaar in the PAN slot, a password-locked e-Aadhaar PDF with its password rule, a multi-page PDF, a tiny, blurry or HEIC photo, a screenshot of a screenshot) from cheap in-browser signals plus an optional classify hook, and saying exactly what to upload instead.

items.name: ai-paste-guard
items.title: AI Paste Guard
items.description: Stops hidden prompt injections riding in on a paste: it reads the HTML clipboard data pasted into an AI prompt box, holds the paste when it carries text the person couldn't see (white or same-colour text, zero-size or transparent text, display:none, off-screen and clipped elements, HTML comments, alt or title text with instructions, Unicode tag-character payloads decoded back to ASCII) while ignoring the clipboard's own StartFragment and Word markers, framework comments (WordPress, React, Vue, Angular), gradient text, screen-reader-only labels and light text copied from dark-mode pages (inferred when most of the paste is light, so white-on-white injections still show), shows each passage with injection phrasing marked and whether it would reach a plain-text box, and pastes only the visible text in one tap with an undo.

meta.stops: Hidden prompt injection in a paste

items.name: ssh-key-input
items.title: SSH Key Input
items.description: Stops a private key being pasted where a public key belongs by saying so loudly, telling the user to rotate it and pulling out the public half in one tap, and catches DSA and short RSA keys, keys wrapped across lines or cut off, a missing or wrong type prefix, the SSH2 export format and a key already on the account, showing the SHA256 fingerprint and comment exactly as ssh-keygen prints them.

mistakes: pasted private key instead of public

items.name: jwt-inspect
items.title: JWT Inspect
items.description: Stops live tokens being pasted into online decoders by decoding on the page only, and flags alg none, HS-vs-RS key confusion, an expired token or a future nbf shown in the reader's own time zone, millisecond timestamps, a missing aud or iss, a very long lifetime and secrets or personal data readable in the payload.

items.name: cert-paste-check
items.title: Cert Paste Check
items.description: Stops a broken TLS install by telling a certificate from a private key from a CSR as they are pasted, and catching a chain out of order or missing its intermediate, an expired or soon-expiring certificate, a domain the SANs don't cover (wildcard and CN-only traps included), a self-signed certificate in production and a private key that doesn't match, with one-tap reorder and remove fixes.

mistakes: private key does not match cert

items.name: chmod-input
items.title: Chmod Input
items.description: Stops permission mistakes that leak data or lock people out by reading any mode (644, 0755, u+x, -rwxr-xr-x) back as rwx and plain words, and flagging world-writable files, setuid and setgid, private keys and .env files others can read, a writable ~/.ssh or authorized_keys, execute bits on data files, 775 typed for 755, and short or decimal modes, each with a one-tap safe mode.

items.name: email-change-guard
items.title: Email Change Guard
items.description: Stops people locking themselves out by changing their account email to a typo: it catches misspelled providers (gmial.con) with a one-tap fix, shows exactly where the confirmation stops matching, spots the same inbox (Gmail dots, +tags), says what moves with the address (sign-in, receipts, 2FA codes), and keeps the old address active until the new one is verified, with resend, edit and cancel while it waits.

meta.stops: Locked out by a typo'd new email

items.name: redirect-uri-input
items.title: Redirect URI Input
items.description: Prevents redirect_uri_mismatch sign-in failures and leaked authorization codes by checking a redirect URI the way an OAuth server does, exact string match, so it catches a trailing slash, http versus https, letter case, www or a port that differs from the registered list (with the differing characters highlighted side by side and a one-tap swap), plus localhost in production, wildcards, a default :443 port or empty ?, a #fragment, stray whitespace and short custom schemes.

items.name: csp-input
items.title: CSP Input
items.description: Prevents Content-Security-Policies that look strict but stop nothing by reading the policy the way a browser does: it flags 'unsafe-inline' without a nonce, 'unsafe-eval', * and data: or https: in script-src, a missing default-src, object-src or base-uri, unquoted keywords, a missing semicolon or a stray comma (which splits a header into two policies), allowlisted hosts known to serve JSONP or AngularJS, typo'd or duplicate directives and report-only traps (a Report-Only header pasted as the real one, no report endpoint, a report-only <meta> tag), pins each to its directive in a readout and fixes most in one tap.

items.name: public-env-guard
items.title: Public Env Guard
items.description: Stops secrets shipping in the client bundle by reading a .env the way the bundler does, listing every NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_, REACT_APP_, EXPO_PUBLIC_ or PUBLIC_ variable that reaches the browser, flagging secret key shapes, Supabase service_role JWTs, passwords in URLs, secret names and high-entropy values (while letting publishable keys through), and renaming a key to server-only in one tap with a reminder to rotate it.

meta.stops: Secret key shipped in the bundle

items.name: robots-txt-guard
items.title: Robots.txt Guard
items.description: Stops a robots.txt from quietly de-indexing a site by flagging Disallow: / headed for production, staging leftovers, rules that block the CSS and JS Google renders with (tested against real asset paths), relative or wrong-host sitemaps, directive typos and rules Google ignores, with one-tap fixes and a URL tester that names the line deciding each crawl.

items.name: image-tag-input
items.title: Image Tag Input
items.description: Stops deploys from pulling the wrong container by reading the reference back the way Docker resolves it (implied docker.io/library/ and :latest shown), flagging :latest or no tag in production, tags that move, typo'd or frozen registries, private images that fall back to Docker Hub, malformed digests and arch-specific tags that won't run on the target, with one-tap fixes including pinning a digest.

items.name: invoice-number-check
items.title: Invoice Number Check
items.description: Keeps GST invoice numbers legal under CGST Rule 46(b) by counting to 16, naming the character that isn't a letter, digit, - or /, catching a number already used this financial year even in different capitals (as GST portals compare them), a stale year token, a skipped or reused counter and gaps in the series, and offering the next number with a fresh series from 1 April.

items.name: ctc-breakdown-input
items.title: CTC Breakdown Input
items.description: Stops a job offer's headline CTC being mistaken for pay by splitting it into fixed pay, variable, ESOPs, joining bonus, gratuity and PF, estimating gratuity and PF in one tap, working out monthly in-hand pay with every assumption written down, and flagging offers where in-hand is far below the headline.

items.name: column-mapper
items.title: Column Mapper
items.description: Stops a spreadsheet landing in the wrong fields by checking a column mapping against the values themselves: emails sitting in the phone column, first and last names swapped, DD/MM read as MM/DD (with a readback of what a date becomes), the same field picked twice and required fields left unmapped, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: guest-count-picker
items.title: Guest Count Picker
items.description: Prevents bookings a hotel will bounce by asking each child's age and catching a child over the age limit (or young enough to be a free infant), infants with no adult, rooms over capacity or out of cots, and a room split that doesn't add up to the party, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: pin-drop-check
items.title: Pin Drop Check
items.description: Prevents deliveries to the wrong door by measuring a dropped map pin against the typed address and PIN area (ignoring gaps inside GPS accuracy), flagging pins in water or on a highway from your geo helper, drawing the gap on a to-scale SVG sketch with no map library, and asking "Use pin or address?".

meta.stops: Delivery sent to the wrong door

items.name: boolean-query-input
items.title: Boolean Query Input
items.description: Prevents boolean searches that quietly return the wrong people by showing how the engine will group AND and OR (with the brackets it implies highlighted) and offering the grouping you meant, and by catching unclosed quotes and brackets, curly quotes, [ ] used as brackets, lowercase and/or searched as words and dangling operators, each with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Boolean search returns the wrong people

items.name: salary-input
items.title: Salary Input
items.description: Prevents mis-stated salaries by catching a monthly figure entered as yearly (and back), a bare "12" meant as 12 LPA and an extra zero against the role's range, reading every amount back in lakh/crore, per month and per year, and offering a one-tap fix for each.

items.name: pincode-input
items.title: PIN Code Input
items.description: Prevents parcels going to the wrong place by reading the state from an Indian PIN's first digits as you type (offline) and flagging a mismatch with the picked state, catching O typed for 0, wrong lengths, unused prefixes, Army Post codes and ZIP or UK postcodes typed for India, then reading the area back from a pluggable lookup and checking the city, with one-tap fixes.

meta.stops: Parcel sent to the wrong state

items.name: password-hint-guard
items.title: Password Hint Guard
items.description: Prevents password hints and security answers that give the password away (the flaw that exposed millions of Adobe passwords in 2013) by spotting the password inside them, also backwards, spaced out or in leetspeak, a large piece of it, or a 'same as my bank' reuse admission, without ever displaying the password, and removing the leak in one tap.

items.name: cors-origin-input
items.title: CORS Origin Input
items.description: Prevents CORS allow-lists that silently never match or expose the API to every site by catching * with credentials, null, a trailing slash or path, a missing scheme, a default port and http or localhost in production, with one-tap fixes and a tester that names the near miss blocking an origin.

items.name: webhook-url-input
items.title: Webhook URL Input
items.description: Stops a webhook from being pointed somewhere events can't arrive by judging the URL for the environment it's saved to (an ngrok, tunnel, localhost or private-IP URL is an error in production but a hint in test mode, a staging host is flagged, plain http and a missing path get a fix) and diffing it against the last saved URL, warning when only a www or trailing slash changed because senders treat the resulting redirect as a failure, with a one-tap revert.

items.name: coupon-input
items.title: Coupon Input
items.description: Stops shoppers giving up on a code that should work by cleaning pasted spaces, hidden characters and case, catching O-vs-0 style look-alikes with a one-tap fix, saying exactly why a code didn't apply (cart minimum with the gap, expiry date, excluded items, already used), showing the real saving and any cap, and asking before a worse code replaces a better one.

items.name: size-fit-picker
items.title: Size Fit Picker
items.description: Prevents wrong-size orders by converting UK, US, EU and IN sizes live without losing the pick, reading back the shopper's usual size adjusted for brands that run small or large, and catching their usual number clicked in the wrong system (US 8 is a UK 7) with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Wrong shoe or clothing size ordered

items.name: paste-target-guard
items.title: Paste Target Guard
items.description: Prevents payments to a clipboard-hijacked IBAN, UPI ID or wallet address by comparing what lands in the field with what was copied on the page or entered earlier, and flagging look-alikes of saved recipients, then showing both side by side in groups (start and end first, differing characters marked, "ends match" called out because modern clippers copy them) with the original one tap away.

items.name: email-input
items.title: Email Input
items.description: Prevents bounced sign-ups from typo'd addresses by spotting misspelled domains like gmial.con or rediffmial.com with Damerau-Levenshtein matching and offering a one-tap, never automatic, fix, and offers matching providers while the domain is still being typed so the typo never happens.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Prevents 'wrong password' lockouts that were really Caps Lock, a non-Latin keyboard layout or a pasted trailing space, by warning about each one as it happens.

items.name: match-field
items.title: Match Field
items.description: Prevents mistyped passwords and bank account numbers by showing exactly which character the confirmation stops matching at, without revealing either value, and by refusing a paste into the confirm box only when it is a copy of the first entry, so password managers keep working.

meta.stops: Mistyped confirm password or account number

items.name: amount-input
items.title: Amount Input
items.description: Prevents paying ten times too much (or too little) by grouping digits live (lakh/crore aware), spelling the amount out like a cheque, and flagging an extra or missing zero against the usual amount with a one-tap fix.

items.name: date-sanity-input
items.title: Date Sanity Input
items.description: Prevents wrong-date bookings by reading the weekday back and catching year typos, past or future dates on the wrong side of today, and weekends, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: clean-paste-input
items.title: Clean Paste Input
items.description: Prevents 'identical' codes and IDs from failing by stripping invisible zero-width, BOM, soft-hyphen and bidi characters on paste with an undo, and flagging any that arrive another way with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Pasted code fails from hidden characters

items.name: otp-paste-input
items.title: OTP Paste Input
items.description: Prevents failed verifications by pulling the right one-time code out of a whole pasted SMS or email while ignoring phone numbers, amounts and order numbers, and accepting digits typed or pasted in any script (full-width, Devanagari, Arabic-Indic).

items.name: url-input
items.title: URL Input
items.description: Prevents broken, insecure and disguised links by adding a missing https://, flagging http, Cyrillic or Greek lookalike hostnames and a “paypal.com@” login prefix that hides the real site, fixing typo'd endings like .con, cleaning the words and full stop a copied sentence leaves behind, and stripping tracking parameters in one tap.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: Prevents saving unreachable numbers by cleaning pasted input (separators, a leading 0, a doubled +91 or 0091), switching country from the dial code and area code (+1 416 is Canada, +1 876 Jamaica), warning on the wrong digit count, checking the digits against Google's libphonenumber ranges and line types (a landline or premium-rate number in an OTP field), and reading back the exact E.164 value.

items.name: char-budget
items.title: Character Budget
items.description: Prevents posts that get cut off and SMS that silently cost double by counting graphemes against X, SMS, LinkedIn and meta-description limits at once, and naming the curly quote or emoji that forced UCS-2.

meta.stops: Post cut off or SMS costs double

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code Input
items.description: Prevents commands, JSON and keys that fail for invisible reasons by disabling autocorrect and catching smart quotes, dashes, ellipses and hidden characters by line and column, with a one-tap fix and optional JSON validation.

meta.stops: Smart quotes break a pasted command

items.name: unit-input
items.title: Unit Input
items.description: Prevents values stored in the wrong unit by noticing when a number is far more plausible in another one (70 cm is probably inches, 98.6 °C is °F) or is typed as 5'9", and offering a one-tap conversion at the right precision or a unit switch.

meta.stops: Height saved in the wrong unit

items.name: time-confirm
items.title: Time Confirm
items.description: Prevents meetings booked 12 hours or a day off by asking AM or PM when a time is ambiguous, spelling out noon and midnight, catching times a DST change skips (with a one-tap move to the real time) or repeats (with a choice of which one), and showing the moment in other time zones with day-shift flags.

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.title: Quantity Stepper
items.description: Prevents accidental bulk orders by clamping to min, max and stock with an explanation, holding big typed jumps for a "Did you mean 10?" confirmation, ignoring the scroll wheel and accelerating on long-press.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: Prevents lost and clobbered edits in click-to-edit text: a cancelled edit can be restored, a failed save keeps your draft, and a value changed by someone else mid-edit is flagged instead of silently overwritten (clicking away then keeps the editor open rather than saving over it).

items.name: checksum-input
items.title: Checksum Input
items.description: Prevents payments and orders going to a mistyped IBAN, card, ISBN or IFSC by checking mod-97, Luhn and ISBN check digits and country lengths as you type, then highlighting the one swapped or doubled character that explains a failure instead of guessing a digit.

meta.stops: Money sent to a mistyped account

items.name: name-input
items.title: Name Input
items.description: Prevents shouty, mangled or swapped names on records by spotting caps lock, all-lowercase, stray digits, doubled spaces and a first/last mix-up, and offering, never forcing, a fix cased the way McDonald, O'Brien, van der Berg and de la Cruz are really written.

meta.stops: Names saved in caps or swapped

items.name: percent-input
items.title: Percent Input
items.description: Prevents 100× rate mistakes by catching 0.15 typed for 15%, 0.25 basis points for 25, and 150% where 100% is the cap, reading the result back in plain money (15% of ₹2,000 = ₹300) and offering a one-tap fix.

items.name: range-pair
items.title: Range Pair
items.description: Prevents filters and bookings built on a backwards, empty or wildly oversized range by catching reversed ends (moving a 28 Dec → 3 Jan end into next year instead of just swapping), equal exclusive ends and year or extra-zero typos, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: schedule-readback
items.title: Schedule Readback
items.description: Prevents shipping a cron job that fires at the wrong time by reading the expression back in plain English, listing the next runs in your own time zone beside the server's, and catching classics like every-minute stars, day-of-month OR day-of-week, the 31st skipping months and 30 February, with one-tap fixes.

meta.stops: Cron job fires at the wrong time
mistakes: cron day of week or month

items.name: near-duplicate-input
items.title: Near-Duplicate Input
items.description: Prevents a second "Marketing" tag by spotting near-duplicates as you type (capitals, spacing, punctuation, plurals, one-letter typos, but never different numbers like Q3 vs Q4) and offering Use existing, which is also what Enter does.

items.name: list-paste
items.title: List Paste
items.description: Prevents importing or inviting a messy pasted list by splitting it on lines, commas, semicolons and tabs (keeping "Shah, Priya" <…> whole), counting valid, duplicate and invalid items with the line and reason for each, and removing the bad ones in one undoable tap, with a pluggable validator.

items.name: slug-input
items.title: Slug Input
items.description: Prevents broken and colliding URLs: the slug follows the title with proper transliteration (Straße → strasse) until published, reads back the full URL, checks for collisions as you type with the next free slug one tap away, and warns that editing a live slug breaks links, keeping a redirect by default.

items.name: env-paste
items.title: Env Paste
items.description: Catches the .env slips loaders accept silently (stray or curly quotes, padded values, a ' #' that cuts a value short, duplicate keys, bad key names, empty values, test keys in production) by showing a parsed table of what the app will actually read, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: split-allocator
items.title: Split Allocator
items.description: Prevents splits that add up to 99%, 101% or leave someone on 0 by showing what's left as you type, giving the rest to any row in one tap, and rounding every automatic split with largest remainder so it sums to the total exactly.

items.name: homoglyph-guard
items.title: Homoglyph Guard
items.description: Stops spoofed usernames and domains like pаypal.com (Cyrillic а) by detecting look-alike, mixed-script, styled and zero-width characters with UTS #39-style rules, naming each one's real script and code point, and offering the plain-ASCII version in one tap.

items.name: json-field
items.title: JSON Field
items.description: Stops broken JSON from being saved by validating as you type, pointing a caret at the exact line and column, and repairing trailing commas, single or smart quotes, unquoted keys, comments, Python literals, missing commas and unclosed braces in one token-aware tap.

items.name: regex-field
items.title: Regex Field
items.description: Catches regexes that look right but aren't (an unescaped dot, a missing ^…$ that lets "abc123x" pass, a greedy .*, catastrophic backtracking like (a+)+) with plain-English hints, one-tap fixes and live-highlighted test strings matched in a time-capped Web Worker that can't freeze the page.

items.name: contrast-picker
items.title: Contrast Picker
items.description: Stops unreadable text colours from shipping by showing the WCAG 2 contrast ratio truncated, never rounded up (#777 on white is 4.47:1 and fails), with AA/AAA marks for normal and large text and a one-tap nearest passing colour that moves only lightness so the hue stays on brand.

items.name: address-check
items.title: Address Check
items.description: Prevents returned parcels by catching a missing flat or house number, a postcode that doesn't fit the country (or fits another one), a city the postcode lookup places elsewhere, and PO boxes couriers can't reach, with one-tap fixes and a live readback of the printed label.

items.name: tax-id-input
items.title: Tax ID Input
items.description: Prevents invoices going out with a mistyped GSTIN, PAN or EU VAT number by recomputing the GSTIN's mod-36 check character, reading back the state, holder type and country, and pinpointing the exact wrong character with a one-tap fix for look-alikes, swaps and GR instead of EL.

items.name: duration-input
items.title: Duration Input
items.description: Prevents wrong timesheet and estimate entries by parsing 1h30, 90m, 1.5h, 1:30 and 2d 4h into one duration read back in words, catching 1.50 typed for 1 h 50 min and asking whether 1:30 is h:mm or m:ss when the limits can't decide.

items.name: filename-input
items.title: Filename Input
items.description: Prevents broken renames by selecting only the base name on focus, warning with a one-tap undo when the extension changes or disappears, and catching illegal characters, Windows reserved names like CON or NUL.txt, trailing dots and spaces, over-long names and duplicates that differ only in capitals.

items.name: coordinate-input
items.title: Coordinate Input
items.description: Prevents pins on the wrong continent by reading decimal, DMS and pasted map links (taking Google's pin, not the map centre), catching swapped latitude and longitude, flipped west or south signs against an expected area and 0, 0 defaults, and reading every point back with an OpenStreetMap link.

meta.stops: Pin lands on the wrong continent

items.name: cidr-input
items.title: CIDR Input
items.description: Prevents misconfigured firewall rules and subnets by reading an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR back as its exact range and address count, catching host bits set (with both the network and single-host readings as one-tap fixes), and warning on 0.0.0.0/0 and on overlaps with existing ranges.

items.name: version-range-input
items.title: Version Range Input
items.description: Prevents dependency ranges that don't mean what you think by reading npm-style semver ranges back in plain English, marking which published versions match and which one installs, and warning about ^0.x lock-in, a hyphen with no spaces, commas for AND and ranges that match nothing.

meta.stops: Semver range installs the wrong version

items.name: zero-result-rescue
items.title: Zero Result Rescue
items.description: Prevents users giving up on an empty search by explaining what got in the way and offering only fixes proven to return results: a did-you-mean from your own vocabulary, the query retyped in the right keyboard layout or without Caps Lock, dropping the filter that hides everything, or searching all categories, each with its result count, counted in memory or by async count-only API calls.

meta.stops: Users quit on empty search results

items.name: mixed-value-field
items.title: Mixed Value Field
items.description: Prevents bulk edits from silently overwriting records by showing "Mixed (3 values)" with the distribution instead of a blank or the first record's value, leaving each record alone unless you pick a value, and reading back exactly what saving changes, counting only the records that actually change.

items.name: card-expiry-input
items.title: Card Expiry Input
items.description: Prevents declined payments from mistyped card expiries by masking MM/YY, reading the date back as valid through the month's last day, and catching month 13, the year typed first, a four-digit year, an expired card and one that runs out before the next renewal, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: username-input
items.title: Username Input
items.description: Prevents impersonation and lost handles by reading back the exact handle that gets registered, blocking reserved words even in disguise (adm1n) and case-only duplicates, flagging look-alikes of existing names with a UTS #39-style skeleton, and checking availability after a pause with free alternatives to tap.

items.name: billing-period-input
items.title: Billing Period Input
items.description: Prevents mispriced plans by reading a recurring price back in every period (₹499/month = ₹5,988/year) and, against a reference price, catching a yearly price typed into the monthly field, a team total entered per seat and other implausible jumps, each with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Yearly price typed into monthly plan

items.name: glob-input
items.title: Glob Input
items.description: Prevents config globs that silently miss or swallow files by running the pattern live against the real file list, flagging no-match and match-everything patterns, the * vs ** mix-up that skips subfolders, ** glued to a name, ./ and backslashes, with one-tap fixes and a dependency-free matcher.

items.name: replace-preview
items.title: Replace Preview
items.description: Stops replace-all from mangling text ("cat" → "dog" turning "category" into "dogegory") by previewing every match in context with a count, naming the matches that sit inside longer words with a one-tap whole-word fix, preserving case, letting you skip single matches and undo the replace.

items.name: i18n-string-field
items.title: i18n String Field
items.description: Stops broken translations shipping by checking each one against its source as it is typed: dropped or renamed placeholders ({count}, %s, {{name}}, …), unclosed tags, ICU plural forms the target language needs per CLDR, rendered length against the UI budget and source text pasted back untranslated, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: sql-guard
items.title: SQL Guard
items.description: Stops a forgotten WHERE from wiping a table: a small tokenizer (comments and strings don't count) flags UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, a WHERE hidden in a comment, always-true conditions like WHERE 1=1, DROP and TRUNCATE as you type, asks before any write on production, shows estimated affected rows from a pluggable function, and requires typing the table name before a destructive run.

items.name: ifsc-input
items.title: IFSC Input
items.description: Prevents bank transfers to the wrong branch by catching the letter O typed for the IFSC's fixed zero, a missing 0, digits in the bank code and guessed prefixes like AXIS for UTIB, then reading the branch back from a pluggable lookup (Razorpay IFSC API shape) and warning when it belongs to a different bank than the one picked.

meta.stops: Transfer sent to the wrong branch

items.name: upi-id-input
items.title: UPI ID Input
items.description: Prevents UPI payments to a typo'd or wrong VPA by cleaning pasted upi://pay links, catching emails, typo'd handles (@okaxsi), app names typed as handles (@gpay), wrong-length or +91 phone IDs and the retired @paytm, then reading back the registered name from a pluggable check and flagging when it differs from the expected name or the name the link claimed, with every message overridable for translation.

meta.stops: UPI payment to the wrong VPA

items.name: shift-time-input
items.title: Shift Time Input
items.description: Prevents wrong timesheets and rosters by reading 22:00–06:00 as an 8 h shift that ends the next day, asking whether 9:00–5:00 meant 5 PM (and whether 10–6 is a day or a night shift) instead of logging 20 h, questioning 0 h, over-long and 26:00-style entries, and deducting the break while catching one typed in hours, and, given the day and time zone, counts the real hours when the clocks change mid-shift (a 22:00–06:00 night is 9 h when they fall back).

items.name: dimension-input
items.title: Dimension Input
items.description: Prevents wrong sizes on listings, shipments and orders by labelling each side, filling all three from a pasted "16 x 12 x 8 in", and checking them against what is being measured to catch the wrong unit, a side with an extra digit and sides entered in the wrong order, then reading the size back in metric and imperial with volume and courier volumetric weight.

items.name: markdown-check
items.title: Markdown Check
items.description: Catches Markdown that will render differently from how it reads (an unclosed ** or backtick, [text] (url) with a space, empty or space-broken links, #Title with no space, raw HTML the sanitizer strips) and previews each spot the way it will actually render, with a one-tap fix.

items.name: yaml-field
items.title: YAML Field
items.description: Catches YAML that loads without an error but means something else (NO, yes, on and off read as booleans, 1.10 read as 1.1, 0755 as octal, 22:22 as base-60, duplicate keys, tabs and misaligned indentation) by showing each one's line, column and what the parser will really read, with one-tap quoting and alignment fixes.

items.name: shortcut-recorder
items.title: Shortcut Recorder
items.description: Stops users saving a keyboard shortcut that will never fire or will clobber something, by checking what they press against browser and OS reserved keys on every platform (Ctrl+W, ⌘Q, Ctrl+T), the app's own bindings and layouts where the key needs AltGr, then reading it back as ⌘ on Mac and Ctrl on Windows/Linux.

items.name: webhook-test
items.title: Webhook Test
items.description: Stops a webhook from being saved to a URL the sender can't deliver to, by flagging localhost and private IPs, plain http, a missing path and tunnel URLs, then judging a pluggable test delivery the way the sender will: redirects fail (with a one-tap switch to the final URL), slow replies near the timeout and 200 login pages are caught.

meta.stops: Webhook saved to an unreachable URL

items.name: hashtag-input
items.title: Hashtag Input
items.description: Catches hashtags that quietly fail (a space or apostrophe that cuts the tag short, case-only duplicates, all-digit or banned tags, posts over a platform's limit) and suggests CamelCase like #OpenSource so screen readers say the words, each with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Hashtag cut short by a space

items.name: tax-inclusive-input
items.title: Tax-Inclusive Input
items.description: Stops tax being added twice by making 'includes / excludes GST' an explicit toggle, reading back net + tax = gross, and flagging an 'excludes' price that divides back to a round number, a mode switch that silently changed the total, or a typo'd rate like 0.18 or 180.

meta.stops: GST added twice to a price

items.name: timezone-picker
items.title: Timezone Picker
items.description: Prevents scheduling in the wrong zone: search by city, country or abbreviation, with ambiguous ones like IST or PST listing every meaning instead of guessing, each result showing local time and UTC offset, plus warnings for a clock change in the coming weeks and a zone that differs from the device's.

meta.stops: Meeting scheduled in the wrong zone

items.name: scope-picker
items.title: Scope Picker
items.description: Stops over-privileged API keys by reading back in plain words what the key can do (destructive powers in red), flagging write, delete and admin scopes, offering 'Only what you've used' from real usage, and warning when the key never expires.

meta.stops: API key with admin powers leaks

items.name: brand-color-input
items.title: Brand Color Input
items.description: Stops near-miss brand colours from shipping by naming the closest palette token with a perceptual (OKLab) distance and offering a one-tap snap when a value is a hair off (#1e40ae vs #1e40af), and by catching pasted junk, the letter O for zero, a digit too many or few, alpha hidden in 4- and 8-digit hex, and Android #AARRGGBB order that CSS renders as a different colour.

meta.stops: Brand colour off by a hex digit

items.name: version-bump
items.title: Version Bump
items.description: Stops breaking changes shipping as a minor or patch that every ^range installs automatically by reading the changes (Conventional Commits or tagged), marking the bump they need, previewing each option's version, warning when the pick is too small (or a needless major), and reading back "1.4.2 → 2.0.0" with who gets it, while handling 0.x's shifted breaking slot, pre-release tags that drop on release, and tags that sort backwards (2.0.0-beta.0 < 2.0.0-rc.1).

meta.stops: Breaking change shipped as a minor

items.name: dose-input
items.title: Dose Input
items.description: Prevents ten-fold medication errors by flagging the ISMP error-prone dose designations as they're typed (trailing zeros like 1.0 mg read as 10 mg, a missing leading zero, U and IU, µg, cc, a unit flush against the number, uncommaed big numbers), rewriting the dose safely in one tap, offering the likely meant value when a dose is 10× outside the drug's usual range (mg typed for mcg, a slipped decimal), and spelling it back in words.

items.name: wrong-layout-input
items.title: Wrong Layout Input
items.description: Catches text typed with the wrong keyboard layout ("ghbdtn" meant "привет", "руддщ" meant "hello", plus Hebrew, Greek and Hindi InScript) by scoring it against letter-pair models of each language and spellings no real word has, then offers the retyped text as a one-tap fix with undo, leaving names, acronyms, links and code alone.

meta.stops: Text typed in the wrong keyboard layout

items.name: utm-check
items.title: UTM Check
items.description: Stops campaign links that fragment analytics by catching, as the URL is built or pasted, mixed case and spaces (Facebook vs facebook, "Diwali Sale" vs diwali_sale, or a value your reports already spell differently), source and medium swapped, a medium GA4's default channel rules file as organic or Unassigned, misspelled keys, a second "?", tags after "#" and tags on links back to your own site, reading back the GA4 channel and fixing each in one tap or all at once.

items.name: reorder-readback
items.title: Reorder Readback
items.description: Stops a slipped drag from silently reordering priorities, fallbacks or steps by reading every drop back with its consequence ("Moved Razorpay from 3rd to 1st. It's now tried first.") with Undo, dragging only from the grip so touch scrolling never reorders, refusing to push pinned rows aside with a reason, marking rows moved since the last save, and meeting WCAG 2.2 2.5.7 with click-and-arrow moves plus Space/arrow/Escape keyboard moves with debounced announcements.

items.name: nominee-check
items.title: Nominee Check
items.description: Stops a bank, locker or demat nomination that won't do what the holder thinks, by checking it against the 2025 bank nomination rules and SEBI's 2026 limits: shares that don't add to 100%, a fifth bank nominee (or fourth demat one) that won't count, a split on a locker that can only go in order, a demat nominee with no relationship or a minor with no date of birth, a minor with no adult to receive, the same person twice and no nominee at all, then reading back in plain words who gets what, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: passport-validity-check
items.title: Passport Validity Check
items.description: Stops travellers booking a trip their passport can't make by checking it against the destination's rule (the 6-month rule, Schengen's 3 months after you leave and 10 years since issue, blank pages), naming the exact date it must last until and offering the latest return date that would pass, with sourced default rules you can replace.

items.name: seat-gap-check
items.title: Seat Gap Check
items.description: Stops groups checking out with seats they'll regret by catching a party split across the row, a single empty seat left behind (which many cinemas and theatres refuse) and a child seated away from every adult, marking the problem seats and moving everyone to the nearest block that fits, children beside adults, in one tap.

meta.stops: Group split across row at booking

items.name: formula-overwrite-guard
items.title: Formula Overwrite Guard
items.description: Stops a spreadsheet paste from silently wiping formulas, locked cells or the heading row, or spilling data past the table edge, by previewing in place which cells would change and how, leaving out a heading row the copy dragged along, and offering to paste values only into the empty and non-formula cells, while safe pastes go straight in with Undo.

items.name: passkey-name-prompt

items.name: stale-attachment-check

items.name: heading-outline

items.name: link-text-check

items.name: terms-changes

items.name: hidden-field-guard

items.name: consent-group

items.name: dob-input
items.title: DOB Input

items.name: recurrence-scope

items.name: tree-select-readback

items.name: repeat-rows

items.name: crop-guard

items.name: stay-length

items.name: event-overlap
items.title: Event Overlap

meta.stops: Meeting booked on top of another

items.name: unanswered-check
items.title: Unanswered Check

items.name: cutoff-picker

items.name: trip-date-chain
