items.name: timezone-mismatch
items.title: Timezone Mismatch
items.description: Stops travellers misreading every time by hours: when the device's time zone differs from the account's, it shows both clocks ticking side by side, asks once whether to use the device zone, confirms the answer without losing focus and remembers it per pair of zones, comparing every real clock change from the tz database so zones that only drift apart for a few days (Jerusalem and Athens) still count as different.

meta.stops: Misread every time by hours while travelling

items.name: update-available
items.title: Update Available
items.description: Gets people onto a new deploy without losing work: it polls a version endpoint (or takes a prop), explains what a refresh does, never refreshes while there are unsaved changes and offers "Refresh after I save" instead, and lets "Later" skip only that build.

items.name: revision-banner
items.title: Revision Banner
items.description: Stops people mistaking an old revision for the current document or editing it by accident: the content is locked in a striped frame that explains blocked edits, and "Restore this version" confirms which latest version it replaces and how many words change.

meta.stops: Edited an old version by mistake

items.name: filter-notice
items.title: Filter Notice
items.description: Stops people thinking data is missing or bulk-acting on a partial set: it says how many items active filters hide, shows each filter as a removable chip with how many items it hides on its own, and warns when selected items are hidden.

meta.stops: Thought data was missing behind a filter

items.name: disabled-reason
items.title: Disabled Reason
items.description: Stops dead-end disabled buttons by keeping the control focusable with aria-disabled and explaining on hover, focus or tap exactly what blocks it, in a portalled panel no overflow-hidden toolbar can clip, with a one-tap jump to each fix, a shake when a blocked press lands and each cleared blocker sliding out of the list.

meta.stops: Disabled button with no reason given

items.name: quota-forecast
items.title: Quota Forecast
items.description: Stops teams hitting a usage limit by surprise by projecting the current rate to the reset ("At this pace you'll run out Thu 22 Oct"), turning amber or red on that forecast, and saying what happens at the limit.

meta.stops: Hit the usage limit by surprise

items.name: resume-marker
items.title: Resume Marker
items.description: Stops readers losing their place in long feeds and docs by remembering the item they rested on, marking it "You were here" on return, and offering a jump there (and back) instead of moving the page on its own.

meta.stops: Lost my place in a long feed

items.name: new-content-pill
items.title: New Content Pill
items.description: Stops live feeds shifting posts under the reader's finger by holding new arrivals behind a "5 new posts" pill that inserts and scrolls up on tap, inserting directly only when the reader is at the top (or scrolls back up to it) and not mid-press; works in its own scroll box or on a page that scrolls as a whole (scrollTarget="window").

meta.stops: Feed jumped while I was tapping

items.name: presence-lock
items.title: Presence Lock
items.description: Stops two people silently overwriting each other's edit of the same field: it shows who is editing what ("Priya is editing Price"), softly locks that field in their colour with an "Edit anyway" that warns once, never locks someone already typing, and releases locks held by people who went idle; transport-agnostic, with animated join and leave.

meta.stops: Two people editing the same field

items.name: unsent-marker
items.title: Unsent Marker
items.description: Stops people believing they replied when their text never left the box: a left-behind draft comes back as a dashed "Not sent · Priya hasn't received it" bubble in the thread, right where the reply would be, with Send, Edit and a two-tap Discard, plus a "Not sent:" preview for conversation lists.

meta.stops: Thought I replied but never sent it

items.name: presenter-mode
items.title: Presenter Mode
items.description: Stops emails, amounts and keys leaking on a screen share: values wrapped in <Sensitive> are removed from the page (not blurred) behind fixed-length masks while presenting, a visible Presenting bar shows the mode is on, a deliberate hold peeks one value, and starting getDisplayMedia in the tab suggests turning it on.

meta.stops: Leaked a key on a screen share

items.name: locale-notice
items.title: Locale Notice
items.description: Stops numbers and dates being misread across locales by showing the value as you write it and as the reader's locale writes it, saying exactly what they would take it to mean ("In Germany, 1,000 reads as 1"), offering a form neither side can flip, and catching numbers typed with the other convention's decimal mark ("1,5" becoming 15).

items.name: progress-heartbeat
items.title: Progress Heartbeat
items.description: Stops people waiting on a dead job or killing a live one by telling working from stalled (no heartbeat for N seconds → "No progress for 40s" with Retry), separating "alive but not advancing" from silence, showing a time-left range that widens instead of a jumpy countdown, and holding the bar at 99% until the job reports done.

meta.stops: Killed a job that was still running

items.name: account-switch-guard
items.title: Account Switch Guard
items.description: Prevents acting as the wrong account when several are signed in by naming who the action runs as and who it is not ('Posting as Acme Corp, not Tushar'), and by catching a switch made in another tab so the button changes to name the page's account instead of silently acting as the new one.

mistakes: posted from company account by mistake

items.name: maintenance-window
items.title: Maintenance Window
items.description: Prevents work lost to planned downtime with a banner in the reader's own time zone whose countdown sharpens as it nears, a start button that warns when a long job would be cut off, and a read-only state during the window that keeps unsaved edits in place and guards against reloads.

mistakes: site down for maintenance lost work

items.name: permission-pre-ask
items.title: Permission Pre-Ask
items.description: Prevents a wasted one-shot browser permission prompt by explaining why and what for in the page before calling the real API, telling a closed prompt from a block, and showing this browser's exact re-enable steps, then flipping to on by itself once the user allows it.

meta.stops: Wasted the browser's one permission prompt

items.name: clock-skew
items.title: Clock Skew
items.description: Catches a device clock that's off from server time (Date header or prop), says by how much and what breaks because of it (authenticator codes, "expires in" timers, secure sites), and corrects the countdowns inside it; the warning clears itself once the clock is fixed.

meta.stops: Wrong phone clock breaks OTP codes

items.name: private-mode-notice
items.title: Private Mode Notice
items.description: Warns before someone relies on drafts or “Remember me” in a browser that won't keep them (private window, blocked site data or a full quota), proving it with a real write test before guessing, offering to export unsaved work and guarding the tab from closing.

items.name: experimental-badge
items.title: Experimental Badge
items.description: Stops people trusting an unfinished feature blindly: the badge opens a plain list of concrete risks (work may be lost, things may change or disappear), a feedback link and a one-tap switch back to the stable version that says what happens to their work.

meta.stops: Trusted a beta feature and lost work

items.name: retry-after
items.title: Retry After
items.description: Stops rate-limit spam from extending a lockout: on 429/503 it reads Retry-After (seconds or a server-dated time) and RateLimit headers, explains which limit was hit and when it resets, counts down, swallows impatient clicks and retries automatically with jitter while the user's input stays put.

items.name: low-battery-guard
items.title: Low Battery Guard
items.description: Stops a long upload, export, call or exam dying halfway on a flat battery: before it starts it compares the battery's runway (to a safety reserve, from the Battery Status API or a measured drain rate) with the task's length, draws where the battery would cut it off, and offers "Start when plugged in", which starts the task the moment a charger connects, staying silent when the task will finish anyway.

meta.stops: Upload died on a flat battery

items.name: data-cost-notice
items.title: Data Cost Notice
items.description: Stops a big download, upload or autoplay eating a data plan or hanging on a slow line: on Data Saver, mobile data or a slow connection (Network Information API, or a Save-Data header passed in) it shows the size and an honest rough time (never calling a line at Chrome's 10 Mbps cap slow, uploads as "over"), offers the lighter version with what it saves, or waits for Wi-Fi and then starts by itself.

meta.stops: Big download ate the mobile data pack

items.name: sunset-notice
items.title: Sunset Notice
items.description: Stops an API shutdown arriving as a surprise outage: it reads the Sunset (RFC 8594) and Deprecation (RFC 9745) headers and their Link relations off a response, lists exactly what stops working, shows when in the reader's own zone (flagging when that falls on a different day than the header's UTC date), counts down while turning amber then red, and lets "Remind me later" snooze only until the next 30/7/1-day mark.

meta.stops: API shutdown arrives as an outage

items.name: print-guard
items.title: Print Guard
items.description: Stops the printout that doesn't match the screen: before printing it finds light text on dark backgrounds the browser will drop, collapsed sections, tables wider than the page (measured at their narrowest), scroll boxes that print only what's in view and links without their address, offers print-only fixes that never change the screen, and since Ctrl+P can't be stopped, fixes those printouts automatically and offers a review.

items.name: bcc-guard
items.title: Bcc Guard
items.description: Stops a group email exposing everyone on it by showing the To line exactly as one recipient will see it, counting the names, private addresses and companies it gives away, flagging when being on the list is itself sensitive ("HIV", "arrears") and offering one email each, moving every outside recipient to Bcc in one tap with Undo, and asking for a second press to send while addresses still show.

meta.stops: Patient list exposed in To field
mistakes: newsletter sent with everyone in to

items.name: hidden-content-check
items.title: Hidden Content Check
items.description: Stops a shared spreadsheet, document or deck leaking what isn't on screen by opening the .xlsx, .docx or .pptx in the browser before it goes out, with no dependencies, and listing hidden and very hidden sheets, hidden rows and columns, tracked deletions, hidden text, comments, speaker notes, hidden slides, embedded workbooks, links to internal drives and author details, opening on the worst one with the hidden tab's real first rows, letting each be kept or removed (the cleaned file is re-checked) and asking for a second press to share with items still open.

items.name: prompt-data-guard
items.title: Prompt Data Guard
items.description: Stops customer data, secrets and confidential documents going into an AI chat by saying before send exactly what goes where and for how long ("248 customer rows and a CONFIDENTIAL doc will go to OpenAI, kept up to 30 days"), counting table rows and every cell in a name column (and every other mention of those names) alongside checked emails, phones, cards, Aadhaar, PAN and API keys across the message and its attachments, then sending in one tap with consistent stand-ins (‹EMAIL_1›) whose mapping stays on the device so restoreStandIns() puts the real values back into the reply, with a second press needed to send the real data.

items.name: bill-split-check
items.title: Bill Split Check
items.description: Stops a bill split that quietly overcharges someone by checking an item-by-item split against the printed receipt, catching unclaimed items, tax counted twice, a tip on top of a service charge, a total that doesn't match and what an equal split costs the lightest eater, each with a one-tap fix and Undo, with shares rounded by largest remainder so they always add up and each row saying who owes the payer what.

meta.stops: Tip added on top of service charge
mistakes: tip and service charge both paid
item nobody claimed on the bill
equal split unfair to light eater

items.name: callback-number-check
items.title: Callback Number Check
items.description: Stops expensive and scam callbacks by saying what a number you're about to call back really is (country and line type, from libphonenumber) and flagging a Caribbean +1 876 number posing as a US area code, a one-ring missed call from abroad, premium-rate and shared-cost lines, toll-free numbers that are only free in their own country, unassigned ranges and a 'bank' number missing from the bank's published list, with risky calls needing a second press as the Call button morphs into 'Call anyway' in place.

meta.stops: Called back a premium-rate scam number

items.name: quote-lock
items.title: Quote Lock
items.description: Stops paying a re-quoted price you never saw: it shows a held FX, swap or fare quote draining, fetches a fresh one when the hold ends (skew-proof with validFor), rolls the amount from old to new with the difference called out, turns a worse-than-tolerance price into an explicit Accept step by morphing the Pay button in place, re-quotes a Pay pressed in the hold's last seconds, keeps the amount in the Pay label, and ignores stale responses and double presses.

meta.stops: Paid a re-quoted price I never saw

items.name: calendar-external-guest-guard
items.title: Calendar External Guest Guard
items.description: Stops an internal meeting invite reaching outside guests with more than you meant to share: it names who is outside your domains (and a colleague's personal Gmail standing in for their work address, with the work address one tap away), then lists what those guests really get under Google Calendar's rules, such as an agenda line marked internal, a file name they can read even without access, an "anyone with the link" attachment, the guest list and invite or edit rights, each with a one-tap fix and Undo, and asks for a second, deliberate press before sending with serious items still open.

meta.stops: Internal agenda shared with outside guests

items.name: chat-audience-check
items.title: Chat Audience Check
items.description: Stops a sensitive message landing in a group chat with someone who shouldn't be there (the slip that put a journalist, shown only as "JG", in US officials' Signal chat in 2025): before it sends it flags members whose name disagrees with what you saved them as, names nobody can identify, people who joined after your last message and people from outside your organisation, stays a quiet one-liner for ordinary messages, and when the text looks sensitive or an identity doesn't add up lists those people with Remove, View profile and "I know them" and needs a second, deliberate press to send.

meta.stops: Secret message reached a stranger in group

items.name: out-of-office-check
items.title: Out of Office Check
items.description: Stops an auto-reply that says the wrong thing to the wrong people: it reads back exactly when replies go out (Gmail's end date runs to 11:59 PM) and who gets which text, compares the dates with the return date written in the message to catch replying all day on the day you're back, stopping days early, no end date and a date left over from last time, and flags outside replies that give strangers a phone number, a colleague's direct address, where you are or a health reason, or that answer every outside sender, each with a one-tap fix and Undo.

meta.stops: Auto-reply runs on the day I'm back

items.name: retract-window
items.title: Retract Window
items.description: Stops people trusting an unsend or edit that won't work: under a sent message it shows how long Edit and Unsend really stay open on that platform (sourced iMessage, WhatsApp and Slack presets, or your own) with a draining bar that turns amber near the end, says who has already read it and whose app will keep the original anyway, keeps "Delete for me" apart and labelled as leaving everyone else's copy, reports who still has it after an unsend, and offers a correction once the windows close, announcing only a window closing, never the countdown.

meta.stops: Trusted an unsend that didn't work

items.name: card-bill-pay
items.title: Card Bill Pay
items.description: Stops a credit card bill being paid in a way that quietly costs interest by reading back, before Pay, what the chosen amount really does: anything short of the total (even 40 paise, unless the statement forgives that shortfall) loses the interest-free days on the whole bill and on new purchases, the minimum is turned into years and rupees of interest, and below the minimum or past RBI's 3-day grace it shows the late fee and the credit-bureau report, with one tap to pay the total.

meta.stops: Minimum due paid, interest charged anyway

items.name: otp-share-guard
items.title: OTP Share Guard
items.description: Stops people reading a one-time code out to a scammer by saying in one sentence what it really approves ("This code approves a ₹24,999 payment to Croma", "This code logs in a new device"), and, when the app knows a call or screen share is active or the code is for a different action than the user started, switching to a strong never-share warning with press-and-hold to see the code, a delayed Copy, a code that is never drawn while the screen is shared, and a one-tap "I didn't request this".

meta.stops: OTP read out to a scammer

items.name: bank-transfer-timing
items.title: Bank Transfer Timing
items.description: Prevents Indian bank transfers that get refused or land later than expected by reading back when the money arrives on the chosen rail (seconds on IMPS and UPI, the next half-hourly NEFT batch and its 2-hour credit window, RTGS within 30 minutes, branch hours and holidays), catching RTGS under ₹2 lakh, IMPS over ₹5 lakh, UPI over its category cap, the bank's own daily limit and a new payee's cooling period and first-day cap with the rail that works one tap away, and spelling the amount out in lakh and crore.

meta.stops: Transfer refused or credited a day late

items.name: gift-card-scam-guard
items.title: Gift Card Scam Guard
items.description: Stops someone paying a scammer with gift cards: at checkout it spots the classic patterns (a large total, several cards, a note about a boss, tax, police, a refund or tech support, sending the codes, a first gift card order), says plainly that no real company or agency takes payment in gift cards, and won't continue until the user answers one question, with "someone asked me to" ending at a stop screen instead of payment. Size limits follow the order's currency, and scam phrases include common Hinglish and Hindi ones such as "sir ne bola".

meta.stops: Paid a scammer in gift cards

items.name: commit-secret-guard
items.title: Commit Secret Guard
items.description: Stops a credential going into a commit by scanning only the lines a diff adds for provider keys, private keys, passwords in URLs, hard-coded secrets and high-entropy strings, flagging .env and key files, ignoring test fixtures by pattern (except live key formats), and offering per-finding fixes (move to an env variable, remove the line, or mark a false positive) with a rotate-now warning when the change is already pushed.

items.name: publish-preview
items.title: Publish Preview
items.description: Stops an npm publish shipping the wrong files or failing for good by previewing the npm pack --dry-run --json tarball and flagging .env files and keys, source maps, tests, repo config, large files, entry points missing from the build (with the reason: .gitignore fallback, files list or no build), a version that's already published, private: true and a missing files allowlist, with one-tap fixes that wait for a fresh pack before they count.

items.name: upi-autopay-review
items.title: UPI AutoPay Review
items.description: Stops a ₹199 plan being approved as a ₹9,999 "as presented" mandate that never ends by reading the cap, schedule, validity and merchant back against the plan before the PIN, flagging a cap far above the price, no fixed schedule, no end date, the wrong merchant and debits above the RBI PIN-free limit, with one-tap fixes to cap it at the plan price or end it in a year.

items.name: upi-collect-guard
items.title: UPI Collect Guard
items.description: Stops people "entering their PIN to receive" money by showing a collect request as the payment it is (You pay ₹4,999 to…), asking whether they expect money and turning a yes into a decline-only stop, and flagging refund, prize, OLX-buyer and KYC wording, person-to-person collects (switched off by NPCI on 1 Oct 2025), unknown requesters and small test amounts before the PIN screen.

meta.stops: Entered UPI PIN to receive money
mistakes: upi pin to receive money scam

items.name: tds-invoice-total
items.title: TDS Invoice Total
items.description: Stops Indian freelancers being short-paid by working out fee + GST − TDS = what lands in the bank, with the right rate and section for the invoice date (10% professional, 2% technical, 1%/2% contract; s.393 of the 2025 Act, was 194J/194C) and the yearly threshold, then flagging TDS taken on the GST, the wrong rate and the 20% rate without a PAN, with a one-tap fix and a ready note for the client.

meta.stops: Freelancer short-paid after TDS on GST

items.name: link-access-check
items.title: Link Access Check
items.description: Prevents "I can't open the link" and accidental public sharing by checking every Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Notion, Figma or Box link in a message against its recipients before it is sent, naming who can't open each one with one-tap fixes (give view access, open it to the company, or ask the owner when you can't share it), and warning when an anyone-with-the-link doc is going outside the organisation.

meta.stops: Shared a link they can't open
mistakes: recipient can't open google drive link

items.name: reply-all-guard
items.title: Reply All Guard
items.description: Stops the reply all nobody wanted by stating how many people it really reaches (distribution lists expanded), naming everyone outside the organisation by domain, catching a BCC'd or forwarded-to recipient about to reveal themselves (without false alarms when the mail came through a list you're on) and a Reply-To that points elsewhere, with one tap to reply to the sender only or leave out external people, and Undo.

meta.stops: Reply all to the whole company

items.name: duplicate-payment-guard
items.title: Duplicate Payment Guard
items.description: Stops paying the same payee the same amount twice by telling a double tap (swallowed, charged once), a retry after a timeout (the first may still land, so it offers Check status before paying again) and a deliberate repeat ("You paid Ravi ₹2,400 12 min ago", needing a separate second press) apart.

items.name: bulk-send-guard
items.title: Bulk Send Guard
items.description: Stops an SMS, WhatsApp or email blast going out wrong by stating before send how many it reaches, how many opted out and are left out, who is in quiet hours in their own time zone (held until morning by default), the cost and a jump over the last send, then requiring an explicit confirm that a double click can't trigger, with the count typed when the jump is big.

items.name: pii-post-guard
items.title: PII Post Guard
items.description: Stops people posting their phone number, email, address, Aadhaar, PAN, card number or an OTP to a public feed, comment or review by saying who will see it, finding each detail with real checks (Verhoeff, Luhn, PAN holder type, OTP keywords) rather than loose digit runs, and masking one or all of them in one tap the way each format expects (XXXX XXXX 1234).

meta.stops: Aadhaar number posted in a public comment

items.name: recurring-charge-readback
items.title: Recurring Charge Readback
items.description: Prevents trial-to-paid and intro-price surprises by reading back, next to the subscribe button, what's charged today, when the first real charge and any price step-up land, and the exact cancel-by time with zone, and by flagging a trial too short to cancel in time or a button whose words ("free", "₹499/mo" on yearly billing) disagree with the charge.

meta.stops: Free trial quietly became a paid plan

items.name: gst-invoice-check
items.title: GST Invoice Check
items.description: Stops GST invoices going out under the wrong tax head by comparing the supplier GSTIN's state code with the place of supply to pick CGST + SGST/UTGST or IGST (SEZ and exports always IGST), then checking each rate against the slabs in force on the invoice date (including the 28% slab ending on 1 Feb 2026), zero-rated LUT exports, the CGST/SGST split, every amount and the total, with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: GST invoice under the wrong tax head

items.name: role-preview
items.title: Role Preview
items.description: Prevents over-granting access by showing exactly what the chosen role can and can't do, diffing it against the current role, and suggesting a smaller role when the pick adds dangerous permissions.

meta.stops: Gave a teammate admin by mistake

items.name: visibility-picker
items.title: Visibility Picker
items.description: Prevents accidental oversharing: narrowing is instant, but widening (a riskier level or simply more people) shows exactly who gains access and only goes through on an explicit confirm, so a double-click or arrow key can't publish anything; levels a policy blocks say why, and a failed save puts the old level back and says so.

meta.stops: Made a private doc public by accident

items.name: recipient-check
items.title: Recipient Check
items.description: Prevents misaddressed email by marking external recipients in amber, catching typo'd and lookalike domains with a one-tap fix, blocking duplicates, spotting a name paired with someone else's address, and warning when a message goes to too many people.

meta.stops: Email sent to the wrong address

items.name: secret-paste-guard
items.title: Secret Paste Guard
items.description: Stops credentials leaking into chats and forms by spotting API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and high-entropy strings as they are pasted or typed, then offering one-tap Redact (keeping the last 4) or Keep.

items.name: external-link
items.title: External Link
items.description: Prevents clicking through to a phishing or unexpected site by confirming off-site links with the real ASCII destination and its registrable domain in bold, and flagging punycode, lookalike domains, link text that disagrees with the href, buried brand names, raw IPs and plain http.

meta.stops: Clicked through to a phishing site

items.name: charge-summary
items.title: Charge Summary
items.description: Prevents surprise charges by showing today's amount, the first charge and renewal dates, taxes and one-time credits upfront, and a plain-language sentence of what you'll pay.

items.name: send-time-check
items.title: Send Time Check
items.description: Prevents messages landing at 2 AM, on the recipient's weekend (including Friday–Saturday weekends) or on a holiday by showing their local time next to Send on a strip of their day (night, working hours, now), and offering a one-tap schedule for the start of their next working day that glides the marker to the slot it picks.

meta.stops: Message landed at 2 AM their time

items.name: fill-before-copy
items.title: Fill Before Copy
items.description: Prevents pasting broken commands that still contain <YOUR_API_KEY> or {{project_id}} by turning each placeholder into an inline field and blocking Copy (or asking once) until all of them are filled.

meta.stops: Pasted a command with YOUR_API_KEY in it

items.name: photo-location-guard
items.title: Photo Location Guard
items.description: Stops a photo from publicly revealing where and when it was taken by reading its EXIF and XMP before upload (GPS with its precision, capture time, camera serial, a hidden uncropped preview) and offering a one-tap "Remove location" that re-encodes the photo upright and re-checks the result.

items.name: currency-hint
items.title: Currency Hint
items.description: Prevents budgeting on the wrong number when paying abroad by showing a foreign price with a clearly approximate, dated conversion ("€49.00 ≈ ₹4,520"), pricing a merchant's dynamic currency conversion against the reference rate with a one-tap switch back to the local currency, estimating card fees and flagging stale rates.

meta.stops: Budgeted on the wrong currency abroad

items.name: mention-guard
items.title: Mention Guard
items.description: Prevents accidental mass pings by saying, as you type, how many people @channel, @everyone or a group mention will notify and how many are in other time zones, flagging mentioned people who aren't in the conversation, offering one-tap fixes, and turning Send into an explicit "Notify 1,240 people" confirm that a double press can't trigger.

items.name: share-link
items.title: Share Link
items.description: Prevents oversharing through links by reading every setting back as one sentence ("Anyone with the link can edit until Fri 16 Oct, 5:00 PM"), warning on public edit access and open-ended public links with one-tap fixes, showing a live expiry countdown, flagging when you widen a link you've already copied, and confirming before revoking.

meta.stops: Anyone with the link could edit

items.name: merge-field-check
items.title: Merge Field Check
items.description: Prevents bulk emails and SMS going out as "Hi ," or "{{frist_name}}" by rendering the template for each real recipient, flagging unknown fields, broken braces and recipients with no value (spaces count as empty) with one-tap fixes and fallbacks, and stepping straight to the recipients who would get a gap.

items.name: forward-guard
items.title: Forward Guard
items.description: Prevents oversharing when forwarding or sharing a thread by listing what the new recipients will see for the first time (earlier messages, internal notes, attachments, other people's addresses), skipping messages they were already on, trimming internal notes by default and letting each item be dropped before it goes.

meta.stops: Forwarded internal notes to a client

items.name: payee-check
items.title: Payee Check
items.description: Prevents paying the wrong account by asking the bank who holds it (a pluggable async lookup) and comparing that with the typed name like Confirmation of Payee: match, close match with the real name one tap away, or no match with the name kept hidden and an explicit pay-anyway, plus callouts for first-time payees and large first payments.

meta.stops: Money sent to the wrong account

items.name: csv-export-guard
items.title: CSV Export Guard
items.description: Stops spreadsheets silently corrupting an export by previewing what each column opens as (phone numbers and PIN codes losing leading zeros or their +, long IDs becoming 1.23457E+15, "3-4" turning into a date, cells starting with = + - @ running as formulas) and offering a per-column fix that forces text or neutralises the formula.

items.name: link-unfurl-check
items.title: Link Unfurl Check
items.description: Shows how a link will unfurl before you post it (title, description and image from a pluggable Open Graph fetch) and catches localhost and staging URLs with a swap to the live site, tracking parameters with a one-tap strip, redirects (flagged hard when they land on a sign-in page), and missing or undersized preview images.

items.name: qr-share
items.title: QR Share
items.description: Stops a QR code going out that opens the wrong thing by reading the exact URL back under the code, re-decoding the code it drew to prove nothing was truncated, and warning about localhost, staging, http, invisible characters and links long enough to make a dense code, with one-tap fixes; ships its own dependency-free encoder (byte mode, ECC M).

meta.stops: QR code opens the wrong page

items.name: redact-image
items.title: Redact Image
items.description: Stops a “redacted” screenshot from leaking what it hides: solid boxes only (blur and pixelation can be reversed), padded and snapped to whole pixels, placeable by drag or keyboard, suggestions from a pluggable text detector with an amber nudge for anything sensitive left uncovered, and an export flattened to a fresh PNG that is re-read to prove every box is solid, with no metadata and no aCropalypse-style data after the image end.

items.name: sms-segments
items.title: SMS Segments
items.description: Prevents bulk SMS costing double by splitting the text into the parts carriers bill, naming the curly quote or emoji that forced UCS-2 ('this ’ makes it 3 messages instead of 2'), fixing it in one tap, and reading the total back per recipient count.

meta.stops: One emoji doubled the SMS bill

items.name: export-scope
items.title: Export Scope
items.description: Stops an export quietly going out as page 1 of 250, silently capped, or full of personal data by reading back exactly what the file holds (rows and page, filters, the date range as real dates with a day count, hidden and personal-data columns) with toggles and a one-tap "Export all" or "Mask it" fix.

items.name: invite-check
items.title: Invite Check
items.description: Stops a calendar invite landing at 3 AM, on a guest's weekend or holiday, at a typo'd company domain, with no video link or location, or twice, by showing the start in every guest's own zone, offering the nearest start that suits everyone in one tap, and catching duplicate guests hidden by +tags or Gmail dots and invites already sent.

meta.stops: Invite lands at 3 AM for guests

items.name: large-attachment
items.title: Large Attachment
items.description: Prevents the message that bounces for being too big by checking attachments against each service's real limit (counting email's ~37% Base64 encoding overhead), marking the fewest files that push it over, and showing the resulting size of sending them as a link or compressing, with an honest estimate for files that are already compressed.

meta.stops: Email bounced for a big attachment

items.name: embed-code
items.title: Embed Code
items.description: Prevents pasting an embed that leaks or breaks by reading back what visitors will see and what it tracks, offering a privacy mode and allowed-site list, and catching drafts, private resources and secrets in the URL (token=, sig=) with a one-tap strip before a deliberate second click copies it.

items.name: alt-text-check
items.title: Alt Text Check
items.description: Prevents posting images screen readers can't use by checking each one's alt text for missing text, filenames (IMG_2041.jpg, PXL_…), "image of…" redundancy, copies of the caption and excess length, with per-image status chips, one-tap fixes, a decorative toggle, a words-in-the-image reminder for screenshots, and a post button that jumps to the first problem before posting anyway.

meta.stops: Posted images screen readers can't read

items.name: stale-reply
items.title: Stale Reply
items.description: Prevents replying to a conversation that has moved on by warning "This was 3 weeks ago and 14 newer messages followed", surfacing the newest related messages (and any that already settled it, like "fixed in 2.4.1"), and offering to reply to the latest or quote the original for context.

meta.stops: Replied to a thread that moved on

items.name: tip-picker
items.title: Tip Picker
items.description: Prevents overtipping by saying whether the percent is on the pre-tax or post-tax amount (with a switch), showing every preset in money that rolls to its new value when the base changes, flagging a service charge already on the bill, and holding back accidental huge tips (250 typed in the % field, 15 typed as money, 100% that doubles the bill), struck through in the summary, until they're fixed in one tap or confirmed.

items.name: refund-picker
items.title: Refund Picker
items.description: Prevents refund surprises and disputes by letting staff or customers pick units per item (or a set amount that can't exceed what the items allow), naming every restocking and return-shipping deduction, keeping non-refundable items visible with the reason, showing each refund method's own net amount and real arrival dates, and reading the whole refund back in one sentence before it's issued.

meta.stops: Refund smaller than the customer expected

items.name: plan-change-readback
items.title: Plan Change Readback
items.description: Prevents surprise charges and lost data on upgrades and downgrades by prorating by day (credit for unused time, charge today, next bill amount and date), saying plainly that a downgrade credit goes to future bills rather than the card, comparing switching now with switching at period end, listing features lost, and showing usage already over the new plan's limits with what happens to the excess, which must be acknowledged before a destructive change.

meta.stops: Downgrade deleted data over the limit

items.name: payment-reference
items.title: Payment Reference
items.description: Prevents bank transfers that can't be matched to an invoice by requiring the invoice number in the expected format (with one-tap fixes for a missing, mistyped or different invoice), checking the reference against each rail's length limit and character set (UPI and IMPS drop symbols, many NEFT remark boxes stop at 30, Faster Payments keeps 18), moving a cut-off invoice number to the front, and previewing the payee's statement line with the cut part struck through.

meta.stops: Transfer couldn't be matched to the invoice

items.name: truncation-preview
items.title: Truncation Preview
items.description: Stops the point of a post vanishing behind "…more" by showing exactly where LinkedIn, Instagram, X, iOS and Android push and Google (by pixel width) cut the text, warning when the key phrase, a link or an @mention X won't notify sits below the fold, and fixing it in one tap by moving that sentence up or removing the blank lines that each cost a whole preview line.

items.name: dockerfile-check
items.title: Dockerfile Check
items.description: Stops a Dockerfile shipping a root, leaky or slow image by reading it the way BuildKit does (escape directive, continuations, heredocs, stages) and flagging a final image that runs as root, secrets in ARG or ENV (Docker's own key rule), secret files baked in or carried over by COPY --from, COPY . before the dependency install, a missing .dockerignore, apt-get without -y, --no-install-recommends or list cleanup, ADD from a URL without --checksum, curl | sh and shell-form CMD or ENTRYPOINT that swallow SIGTERM, with one-tap fixes such as secret mounts, manifest-first installs and exec form.

meta.stops: Docker image runs as root with secrets

items.name: gitignore-check
items.title: Gitignore Check
items.description: Stops secrets and junk getting committed when a .gitignore only looks right: it runs Git's real matching rules against your files and names the line that decides each one, catching inline # comments, trailing tabs, leading spaces, backslashes and ./, ! lines that can't re-include a file inside an excluded folder or are overridden by a later line, / anchors that miss nested folders, .env, keys and node_modules left out, and already-committed files that .gitignore won't untrack (with the git rm --cached command), with one-tap fixes.

items.name: workflow-yaml-guard
items.title: Workflow YAML Guard
items.description: Stops a GitHub Actions workflow handing your repo to anyone who opens a pull request by flagging pull_request_target or workflow_run jobs that check out the PR's code (pwn requests), untrusted ${{ github.event.* }} and head_ref pasted into run scripts, actions pinned to movable tags, missing or write-all token permissions, secrets echoed, dumped with toJSON or transformed past log masking, and self-hosted runners fork PRs can reach, following GitHub Security Lab and GitHub's secure-use docs, with one-tap fixes (env indirection, read-only permissions, pull_request, a hosted runner) and Pin SHA through your own lookup.

items.name: iam-policy-check
items.title: IAM Policy Check
items.description: Stops an AWS IAM or S3 bucket policy granting far more than intended by reading each statement back in plain words (who can do what, on what, only if what) and flagging full-admin and service:* wildcards, Resource "*", Principal "*" that S3 Block Public Access would call public (naming conditions such as aws:SecureTransport or a /1 IP range that don't narrow it), public reads and writes, NotAction with Allow, NotPrincipal traps and iam:PassRole on every role, with scoped one-tap fixes: your account or organization, the actions it really uses, iam:PassedToService inferred from the policy, and a Deny rewritten with aws:PrincipalArn.

meta.stops: S3 bucket made public by policy

items.name: hreflang-check
items.title: Hreflang Check
items.description: Stops Google from silently ignoring hreflang by checking pasted <link> tags or a sitemap for one page or a whole set the way Search Central describes, with a who-links-to-whom grid, and flagging missing or near-miss return links, invalid codes like en-UK or es-419, relative URLs, a missing self-reference or x-default and a canonical that points at another language's page, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: redirect-rule-input
items.title: Redirect Rule Input
items.description: Stops redirect lists from breaking links, SEO and security: it reads vercel.json, Netlify _redirects or nginx rewrite/return (auto-detected) the way each platform matches, then catches loops and 2+ hop chains with the hop path, rules shadowed by an earlier wildcard, open redirects whose domain comes from the URL, 301/308 on temporary moves, 301/302 turning a POST into a GET, dropped query strings, a ?query or #hash written into the source, missing leading slashes, placeholders the source never captures, trailing-slash traps and hops to http, with a GET/POST URL tester and one-tap fixes (collapse the chain, reorder, make temporary, keep args, match the query separately).

items.name: set-cookie-check
items.title: Set-Cookie Check
items.description: Stops cookies from being silently rejected or stolen by reading back what the browser will really do with each Set-Cookie (who gets it, over what, cross-site or not, and for how long after the 400-day cap) and flagging SameSite=None or Partitioned without Secure, broken __Host-/__Secure- prefixes, a Domain that shares a sign-in cookie with every subdomain, a missing HttpOnly, Expires and Max-Age that disagree and the 4096-byte limit, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: qr-scan-check
items.title: QR Scan Check
items.description: Prevents quishing by showing where a scanned QR code really goes before anything opens: the registrable domain in bold against what is printed beside the code (the sticker-over-the-real-code trick, with a one-tap "Go to the printed site instead"), lookalike and brand-borrowing domains, short links followed through a pluggable resolver, app downloads, and for UPI codes the payee, a pre-filled amount and "scan to receive a refund" scams.

items.name: env-diff
items.title: Env Diff
items.description: Prevents broken deploys from config drift by comparing two environments key by key, putting missing and empty keys first, flagging production values that still point at localhost, a test key or the staging host, and secrets reused across both, while masking every secret behind a short fingerprint so the diff is safe to share.

items.name: join-preview
items.title: Join Preview
items.description: Stops a join from silently duplicating or losing rows by predicting the row count for every join type before it runs, naming the repeated keys that fan rows out, counting rows dropped for having no match or a blank key, and catching keys that never match because one side is a number and the other text, or they differ only by spaces, case or leading zeros, each with a one-tap fix that says how many rows it rescues.

items.name: dedupe-key-picker
items.title: Dedupe Key Picker
items.description: Stops a dedupe from merging nothing or merging too much by previewing, as you pick the columns that define a duplicate, how many rows would merge, naming the near-unique column (like a timestamp) that keeps duplicates apart with a one-tap "leave it out", flagging a key so broad one value swallows a quarter of the table, keeping blank keys separate and showing sample collisions with the values a merge would discard highlighted.

items.name: dual-axis-guard
items.title: Dual Axis Guard
items.description: Stops a dual-axis chart from showing a correlation that isn't there by catching zero baselines at different heights and independent ranges that make a +15% line and a +140% line climb in lockstep, saying how much each series really changed, and offering a one-tap "index both to 100" that puts them on one honest scale (with your own chart library through a render prop, or the built-in SVG).

items.name: secret-field
items.title: Secret Field
items.description: Stops masked API keys from leaking or being pasted as dots: keeps the sk_live_/sk_test_ prefix (flagged Live or Test), re-masks on a timer or when the tab is hidden, and copying the masked text puts the real key on the clipboard.

meta.stops: Masked API key pasted as dots

items.name: text-diff
items.title: Text Diff
items.description: Prevents approving an edit you didn't see: a word-level diff that calls out changed numbers (30 → 14) and draws invisible changes like doubled spaces, line breaks and zero-width characters, in inline or split view, and stays fast on long documents with a one-word change.

meta.stops: Approved an edit I didn't see

items.name: readback
items.title: Readback
items.description: Prevents misread license keys, IBANs and Wi-Fi passwords by grouping characters, labelling every look-alike (zero vs letter O, one vs small L), copying the clean value and offering a large show-to-someone view.

items.name: copy-confirm
items.title: Copy Confirm
items.description: Prevents pasting the wrong thing by showing exactly what was copied, refusing to copy an empty value, flagging stray whitespace and invisible characters with a one-tap clean copy, and copying formatted numbers as plain text.

meta.stops: Pasted the wrong thing from the clipboard

items.name: middle-truncate
items.title: Middle Truncate
items.description: Prevents picking the wrong file, wallet or ID by truncating in the middle to the real rendered width so the distinguishing end stays visible, while copy, title and screen readers always get the full value.

meta.stops: Picked the wrong file by prefix

items.name: precise-number
items.title: Precise Number
items.description: Prevents misread amounts by showing big numbers compactly (₹1.2 Cr, $1.2M) without ever rounding up, with the exact value in a tooltip that is never clipped by tables or scroll areas, spoken units, a lakh/crore toggle that visibly rolls the figure to its new units, and honest percentages.

items.name: unambiguous-date
items.title: Unambiguous Date
items.description: Prevents DD/MM vs MM/DD misreadings by showing dates as "3 Oct 2026" with the distance from today, flagging numeric inputs that read two ways with a one-tap choice, and letting one answer apply to a whole imported column.

meta.stops: 03/04 read as March instead of April

items.name: deadline
items.title: Deadline
items.description: Prevents deadlines missed to a time-zone slip or a misread midnight by showing time left plus the exact moment in your zone and the owner's, writing midnight as the end of the day before, and turning amber when close and red when overdue.

meta.stops: Missed a deadline by a time zone

items.name: change-highlight
items.title: Change Highlight
items.description: Stops live updates to prices, counts and statuses going unnoticed by flashing the change once (never more than once a second, skipped under reduced motion), holding a ▲/▼ with good/bad colour and the previous value on hover, and telling returning visitors what changed since their last visit.

items.name: spell-out
items.title: Spell Out
items.description: Stops booking refs, wallet addresses and passwords being misread aloud or copied wrong by grouping the characters, naming look-alikes under the glyph (0 zero vs O oh, 1/l/I, 5/S), spelling it in the NATO alphabet with case when it matters, and flagging Cyrillic look-alike letters and invisible characters.

meta.stops: Booking ref misread over the phone

items.name: honest-bar
items.title: Honest Bar
items.description: Stops a bar chart from exaggerating: when the axis doesn't start at zero it draws a broken-axis mark through the axis and bars, states the distortion ("looks 3×, really 1.09×") with a one-tap Start at 0, tears and labels values past the scale, and reads out exact values on hover and keyboard focus, in pure SVG.

mistakes: y axis not starting at zero

items.name: change-readout
items.title: Change Readout
items.description: Stops changes being misread by showing them both ways (₹1,200 → ₹1,500 · +₹300 · +25%), keeping percentage points apart from percent (4% → 6% is +2 pts, +50%), refusing a % from a zero base or across zero, dividing by |base| for negatives, adding 2.5× when a value doubles, and marking whether the move is good or bad.

items.name: size-context
items.title: Size Context
items.description: Prevents failed uploads and GB-vs-GiB confusion by showing a size with a relatable comparison, transfer time and the equivalent in the other unit system (including what Windows will display), and by checking a limit before upload, flagging the grey zone where a "4 GB" limit only fits if the service means GiB.

meta.stops: Upload fails on GB vs GiB

items.name: sum-check
items.title: Sum Check
items.description: Stops a wrong total from being trusted by re-adding the rows in exact arithmetic, showing the off-by amount, pointing at the rows that would explain it (swapped digits, a slipped decimal, a flipped sign, a debit on the credit side) and saying honestly when the gap is only rounding, with figures that roll to their new values so a one-tap fix is seen landing (the gap counting down to zero) and focus handed to the status after the fix.

items.name: status-chip
items.title: Status Chip
items.description: Stops statuses being misread by never relying on colour alone (a distinct icon shape and text per tone, a colour-blind-safe palette), keeping meanings consistent through one shared status map, and explaining on hover or focus what a status means and what to do next.

meta.stops: Status read wrong by colour-blind users

items.name: sort-indicator
items.title: Sort Indicator
items.description: Stops people misreading a table's order by stating the sort in plain words ("Sorted by Due date, oldest first"), warning when the order comes from a hidden column, empty values or pinned rows, and animating rows to their new place (FLIP, reduced-motion aware) so a re-sort can be followed.

items.name: diff-table
items.title: Diff Table
items.description: Stops people picking the wrong plan or product from a comparison table by marking the cells that actually differ (ignoring case, spacing and 10 GB vs 10GB), offering “Show only differences” that says how many identical rows it hid, and showing blank cells as “Not stated”, never a dash that reads as “No”, while keeping those rows visible.

meta.stops: Picked the wrong plan from a comparison

items.name: amount-in-words
items.title: Amount in Words
items.description: Stops ₹2,50,000 being written or read as ₹25,00,000 by naming every digit group (2 lakh · 50 thousand), spelling the amount cheque-style in lakh/crore or million with paise or cents, showing the other number system alongside, and checking typed words against the figure, since the bank pays what the words say.

items.name: overflow-list
items.title: Overflow List
items.description: Stops a “+3 more” chip list or avatar stack from hiding the item that matters by always keeping failed items, the signed-in user and pinned items visible, and spelling out what the expand button hides (“+4 more, 1 skipped”) instead of a bare count.

items.name: honest-rating
items.title: Honest Rating
items.description: Stops shoppers trusting a bare "4.8" by showing how many reviews stand behind it and how they split, flagging tiny samples with the range the true score could be in, calling out love-it-or-hate-it splits, and sorting by a disclosed Bayesian score so a 5.0 from 3 reviews can't outrank a 4.6 from 900.

items.name: unit-price
items.title: Unit Price
items.description: Stops shoppers picking the pack that only looks cheaper by putting every option on a common unit price (₹ per 100 g, per litre or per piece), marking the true cheapest, and catching bigger packs that cost more per unit, multi-buys that cost more than singles and packs that shrank at the same price, with a one-tap switch.

meta.stops: Bigger pack costs more per kg

items.name: abbr-hint
items.title: Abbr Hint
items.description: Stops readers guessing at jargon (TAT, SLA, kWh) by making each term a dotted, tappable and keyboard-focusable hint instead of a hover-only <abbr title>, spelling it out inline on first use, reading the expansion to screen readers without opening anything, and flagging abbreviations the glossary doesn't cover, with a portalled hint that is never clipped by a scrolling card or table and flips to stay on screen.

meta.stops: Readers guess at jargon like TAT

items.name: error-explainer
items.title: Error Explainer
items.description: Stops people stalling on (or double-submitting after) a raw error code by saying what happened, the likely cause and one next step, waiting out Retry-After, warning that an ambiguous timeout on a payment may already have gone through and offering Check status before Retry, with a support-ready copyable reference and the stack behind Technical details.

meta.stops: Paid twice after a payment timeout error

items.name: partial-period
items.title: Partial Period
items.description: Stops "today so far vs all of yesterday" from reading as a slump by comparing like for like (yesterday cut at the same minute) by default, warning with a one-tap fix when the full period is chosen, hatching the bucket still filling, dimming the part of yesterday not yet reached, and projecting the finish from yesterday's own curve, labelled as an estimate.

meta.stops: Today looks like a slump vs yesterday

items.name: gap-aware-line
items.title: Gap-Aware Line
items.description: Stops missing readings being read as a drop to zero or a smooth trend by breaking the line at nulls, shading and labelling each gap on hover and keyboard focus, keeping a lone reading between gaps visible as a dot, drawing estimated points hollow with dashed segments, and backing every reading with a data table, in pure SVG.

items.name: fair-rank
items.title: Fair Rank
items.description: Stops leaderboards misleading people by ranking ties the standard competition way (1, T-2, T-2, 4) at the precision shown so equal-looking scores always share a rank, showing movement since last period with rows sliding in from where they were, and setting aside entries below a minimum sample with the reason and the rank they would have had.

meta.stops: Tied players shown with different ranks

items.name: eta-range
items.title: ETA Range
items.description: Stops false-precision delivery promises by quoting the range that covers 90% of deliveries with a most likely day only when one really stands out ("Thu 15 – Sat 17 Oct, most likely Fri 16"), counting the shipper's business days, holidays and cutoff in its own time zone, previewing the range you get after the cutoff, naming no-delivery days inside it, and explaining when the estimate widened.

meta.stops: Delivery promised on an impossible day

items.name: palette-guard
items.title: Palette Guard
items.description: Stops chart series becoming indistinguishable for colour-blind readers by simulating protan, deutan and tritan vision (Machado 2009), flagging every pair under a CIEDE2000 threshold that passes Okabe–Ito, and offering the smallest lightness-only fix that clears all clashes, or patterns and direct labels when no colour change can.

meta.stops: Chart colours look identical to colour-blind readers
